@@ -0,0 +1,232 @@
+"""
+Auditoria inicial dos 5 datasets. Reproduz├¡vel, apenas leitura de data/.
+N├úo modifica data/. N├úo calcula receita. N├úo assume ocupa├º├úo externa.
+Gera artefatos em outputs/tables/.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
+pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 100)
+
+
+def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
+    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
+    print(f"   saved -> {OUT / name}")
+
+
+def load(fname: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    df = pd.read_csv(DATA / fname, encoding="utf-8", low_memory=False)
+    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
+    return df
+
+
+def parse_data(df: pd.DataFrame, cols: list) -> None:
+    for c in cols:
+        if c in df.columns:
+            df[c] = pd.to_datetime(df[c], errors="coerce")
+
+
+print("=" * 72); print("CARREGANDO")
+details = load("Details_Itapema.csv")
+hosts = load("Hosts_ids_Itapema.csv")
+mesh = load("Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv")
+price = load("Price_AV_Itapema.csv")
+vr = load("VivaReal_Itapema.csv")
+parse_data(details, ["aquisition_date"])
+parse_data(hosts, ["host_snapshot_date"])
+parse_data(mesh, ["aquisition_date"])
+parse_data(price, ["aquisition_date", "date"])
+parse_data(vr, ["aquisition_date"])
+
+for df_, c in [(details, "airbnb_listing_id"), (mesh, "airbnb_listing_id"),
+               (price, "airbnb_listing_id"), (hosts, "owner_id"),
+               (details, "owner_id")]:
+    df_[c] = df_[c].astype(str).str.strip()
+
+# ---------------- 1. PRICE_AV GRANULARIDADE ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("1. PRICE_AV - GRANULARIDADE")
+price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
+price["stay"] = price["date"].dt.normalize()
+print("capture_day distintos (ignora hora):", price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique())
+print("value_counts por capture_day:")
+print(price["capture_day"].value_counts().sort_index())
+
+price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
+lead_by_day = (price.dropna(subset=["capture_day", "lead"])
+               .groupby("capture_day")["lead"]
+               .agg(["min", "max", "nunique", "count"]))
+print("lead por capture_day (min/max/diasDistintos/nLinhas):")
+print(lead_by_day)
+save(lead_by_day.reset_index(), "audit_price_lead_by_capture_day.csv")
+
+price["d90"] = price["capture_day"] + pd.Timedelta(days=90)
+price["in_d90"] = (price["stay"] >= price["capture_day"]) & (price["stay"] <= price["d90"])
+print("\nfrac linhas dentro de [capture, capture+90]:", round(price["in_d90"].mean(), 4))
+
+key = ["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day", "stay"]
+dups = price.duplicated(subset=key, keep=False)
+print("linhas duplicadas por (listing, capture_day, stay):", int(dups.sum()))
+save(price[dups].sort_values(key + ["aquisition_date"]), "audit_price_duplicates.csv")
+
+grp = price.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"])["aquisition_date"]
+ts_count = grp.nunique().rename("ts_distintos")
+print("\ndistribuicao de timestamps distintos por (listing, capture_day):")
+print(ts_count.value_counts().sort_index())
+
+mts = ts_count[ts_count >= 2]
+print("\npares (listing, capture_day) com >=2 timestamps:", len(mts))
+if len(mts):
+    ex = price.sort_values(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day", "aquisition_date"])
+    ex = ex[ex.set_index(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).index.isin(mts.index)]
+    ex = ex.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).agg(
+        n_ts=("aquisition_date", "nunique"),
+        stay_min=("stay", "min"),
+        stay_max=("stay", "max"),
+        n_stays=("stay", "nunique"),
+    ).head(20)
+    print(ex)
+    save(ex.reset_index(), "audit_price_multi_timestamp_examples.csv")
+else:
+    print("nenhum exemplo.")
+
+# ---------------- 2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV")
+pid = set(price["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
+did = set(details["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
+mid = set(mesh["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
+print("IDs Price_AV:", len(pid))
+print("Price_AV INTER Details:", len(pid & did))
+print("Price_AV INTER Mesh:", len(pid & mid))
+print("Price_AV NOT em Details:", len(pid - did))
+print("Price_AV NOT em Mesh:", len(pid - mid))
+print("Price_AV NOT em (Details e Mesh):", len(pid - did - mid))
+
+px = details[["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]].copy()
+px["has_price"] = px["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(pid)
+px = px.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
+for grp_col in ["suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]:
+    g = px.groupby(grp_col)["has_price"].agg(["size", "sum"])
+    g["frac"] = g["sum"] / g["size"]
+    print(f"\ncobertura por {grp_col} (top por n):")
+    print(g.sort_values("size", ascending=False).head(20))
+    save(g.reset_index(), f"audit_coverage_by_{grp_col}.csv")
+
+# ---------------- 3. HOSTS JOIN RISK ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("3. HOSTS - RISCO DE JOIN")
+n_host_lines = len(hosts)
+n_host_uniq = hosts["owner_id"].nunique()
+print("linhas Hosts:", n_host_lines, "| owner_id unicos:", n_host_uniq)
+freq = hosts["owner_id"].value_counts()
+print("max aparencias de um owner_id:", freq.max())
+print("count de owners por numero de linhas:")
+print(freq.value_counts().sort_index().rename("n_owners"))
+save(freq.reset_index().rename(columns={"owner_id": "owner_id", "count": "n_linhas"}),
+     "audit_hosts_freq.csv")
+
+J = details.merge(hosts, on="owner_id", how="left")
+print("\nlinhas Details:", len(details), "| apos mergo Details x Hosts (how=left):", len(J))
+inner = details.merge(hosts, on="owner_id", how="inner")
+print("linhas se joinar (inner) Details x Hosts:", len(inner))
+
+var_fields = {}
+for col in hosts.columns:
+    if col == "owner_id":
+        continue
+    try:
+        var_fields[col] = hosts.groupby("owner_id")[col].nunique().max()
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+var_df = pd.DataFrame(list(var_fields.items()), columns=["campo", "max_distintos_por_owner"])
+print("\nmax valores distintos por campo dentro de um owner_id:")
+print(var_df)
+save(var_df, "audit_hosts_var_by_owner.csv")
+
+hosts_sorted = hosts.sort_values("host_snapshot_date")
+hosts_latest = hosts_sorted.drop_duplicates("owner_id", keep="last")
+print("\nHosts dedup por snapshot mais recente:", len(hosts_latest), "(esperado =", n_host_uniq, ")")
+save(hosts_latest, "audit_hosts_latest_per_owner.csv")
+
+# ---------------- 4. TESE DOS COMPACTOS ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("4. TESE DOS COMPACTOS (somente amostra)")
+det = details[["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms"]].copy()
+det["bedrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(det["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce").fillna(-1)
+det["tipo"] = details["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
+dc = det.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
+dc["bc"] = dc["suburb"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
+has_price = dc["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(price["airbnb_listing_id"])
+
+studio = dc["bedrooms"] == 0
+one_bed = dc["bedrooms"] == 1
+centro = dc["bc"] == "centro"
+apto = dc["tipo"] == "apartamento"
+
+def show(mask, label):
+    n = int(mask.sum())
+    np_ = int((mask & has_price).sum())
+    print(f"  {label}: n={n}  com Price_AV={np_} (frac={(np_/n) if n else 0:.3f})")
+
+show(studio & centro, "studio (br==0) + centro")
+show(one_bed & centro, "1 quarto + centro")
+show(one_bed & centro & apto, "apartamento + 1 quarto + centro")
+
+# ---------------- 5. RATINGS ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("5. RATINGS (zero vs sem reviews)")
+ct = pd.crosstab(details["number_of_reviews"] == 0, details["star_rating"] == 0)
+print("Details: linhas=>star==0? col=>nrev==0?")
+print(ct)
+save(ct.reset_index(), "audit_ratings_zero_vs_reviews.csv")
+
+cth = pd.crosstab(hosts["number_of_reviews_host"].fillna(-1) == 0, hosts["star_rating_host"] == 0)
+print("Hosts: cruzando star_rating_host==0 x number_of_reviews_host==0:")
+print(cth)
+save(cth.reset_index(), "audit_ratings_host_zero_vs_reviews.csv")
+
+# ---------------- 6. VIVAREAL ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("6. VIVAREAL")
+print("linhas:", len(vr), "| listing_id unicos:", vr["listing_id"].nunique())
+print("duplicatas exatas (todas colunas):", int(vr.duplicated(keep=False).sum()))
+print("listing_id repetidos:", int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()))
+
+def missing_report(df, cols):
+    rec = []
+    for c in cols:
+        s = df[c]
+        na = int(s.isna().sum())
+        blank = int(s.astype(str).str.strip().isin(["", "<NA>", "nan", "None"]).sum())
+        rec.append({"col": c, "missing_na": na, "blank": blank})
+    return pd.DataFrame(rec)
+
+miss = missing_report(vr, ["sale_price", "yearly_iptu", "monthly_condo_fee",
+                           "rental_price", "usable_area", "bedrooms"])
+print(miss)
+save(miss, "audit_vivareal_missing.csv")
+
+for col in ["sale_price", "usable_area"]:
+    num = pd.to_numeric(vr[col], errors="coerce")
+    print(f"\n--- {col} (n={int(num.notna().sum())}):")
+    print(num.describe().round(2))
+    print("top10 maior:")
+    print(num.dropna().nlargest(10).to_list())
+
+vr["suburb_original"] = vr["suburb"]
+vr["suburb_norm"] = vr["suburb"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
+print("\nbusiness_types:", vr["business_types"].value_counts().to_dict())
+save(vr[["listing_id", "suburb_original", "suburb_norm", "sale_price", "bedrooms"]],
+     "audit_vivareal_normalized.csv")
+
+# ---------------- 7. HIPOTESE PRICE/VIVAREAL ----------------
+print("=" * 72); print("7. PRICE_AV: preco apresentado para data disponivel?")
+n_past = int((price["stay"] < price["capture_day"]).sum())
+print("linhas com estadia ANTES da captura:", n_past)
+print("lead min:", price["lead"].min())
+print("frac lead in [0,90]:", round(price["lead"].between(0, 90).mean(), 4))
+print("mean n stays distintos por (listing, capture_day):",
+      round(price.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"])["stay"].nunique().mean(), 2))
+
+print("\nOK")

"""
Auditoria inicial dos 5 datasets. Reproduz├¡veis, apenas leitura dos dados em data/.
N├úo modifica data/. N├úo calcula receita. N├úo assume ocupa├º├úo externa.
Gera artefatos em outputs/tables/.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 100)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda v: f"{v:.2f}")


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"   saved -> {OUT / name}")


def load(fname: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA / fname, encoding="utf-8", low_memory=False)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    return df


def parse_data(a: pd.DataFrame, cols: list) -> None:
    for c in cols:
        if c in a.columns:
            a[c] = pd.to_datetime(a[c], errors="coerce")


print("=" * 72)
print("CARREGANDO")
details = load("Details_Itapema.csv")
hosts = load("Hosts_ids_Itapema.csv")
mesh = load("Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv")
price = load("Price_AV_Itapema.csv")
vr = load("VivaReal_Itapema.csv")
parse_data(details, ["aquisition_date"])
parse_data(hosts, ["host_snapshot_date"])
parse_data(mesh, ["aquisition_date"])
parse_data(price, ["aquisition_date", "date"])
parse_data(vr, ["aquisition_date"])

# ids sao texto (podem ter zeros a esquerda / tamanho grande)
for df_, c in [(details, "airbnb_listing_id"), (mesh, "airbnb_listing_id"),
               (price, "airbnb_listing_id"), (hosts, "owner_id"),
               (details, "owner_id")]:
    df_[c] = df_[c].astype(str).str.strip()

# ---------------- 1. PRICE_AV GRANULARIDADE ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("1. PRICE_AV - GRANULARIDADE")
price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
cap_days = price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique()
print("capture_day distintos (ignora hora):", cap_days)
print("capture_day value_counts:")
print(price["capture_day"].value_counts().sort_index())

price["stay_date"] = price["date"].dt.normalize()
price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days

# janela / lead por dia de captura
lead_by_day = (price.dropna(subset=["capture_day", "lead"])
               .groupby("capture_day")["lead"]
               .agg(["min", "max", "nunique", "count"]))
print("lead por capture_day:")
print(lead_by_day)
lead_by_day.to_csv(OUT / "audit_price_lead_by_capture_day.csv")

# cobertura 91 dias? dist (D .. D+90)
price["d90"] = price["capture_day"] + pd.Timedelta(days=90)
price["in_d90"] = (price["stay"] >= price["capture_day"]) & (price["stay"] <= price["d90"])
print("frac linhas dentro de [D, D+90]:", price["in_d90"].mean())

# duplicacao (listing, capture_day, date)
key = ["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day", "stay"]
dups = price.duplicated(subset=key, keep=False)
print("linhas duplicadas por (listing, capture_day, stay):", int(dups.sum()))
dup_df = price[dups].sort_values([*key, "aquisition_date"]).copy()
dup_df.to_csv(OUT / "audit_price_duplicates.csv", index=False)

# timestamps distintos dentro de um mesmo listing+dia -> numero de capturas
grp = price.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"])["aquisition_date"]
ts_count = grp.nunique().rename("ts_distintos")
print("distribuicao de numero de timestamps (aquisition) por (listing, capture_day):")
print(ts_count.value_counts().sort_index())

# exemplos concretos de listing com varios timestamps num mesmo dia
mts = ts_count[ts_count >= 2]
print("pares (listing, capture_day) com >=2 timestamps:", len(mts))
ex = price[price.set_index(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).index.isin(mts.index)]
ex = ex.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).agg(
    n_ts=("aquisition_date", "nunique"),
    stay_min=("stay", "min"),
    stay_max=("stay", "max"),
    n_stays=("stay", "nunique"),
)
ex = ex.head(20)
print(ex)
ex.to_csv(OUT / "audit_price_multi_timestamp_examples.csv")

# ---------------- 2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV ----------------
print("=" * 72 * 15); print("2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV")
pid = price["airbnb_listing_id"].unique()
did = set(details["airbnb_listing_id"])
mid = set(mesh["airbnb_listing_id"])
print("IDs Price_AV:", len(pid))
inter = set(pid) & did; print("Price_AV INTER Details:", len(inter))
inter_mesh = set(pid) & mid; print("Price_AV INTER Mesh:", len(inter_mesh))
not_in_details = set(pid) - did; not_in_mesh = set(pid) - mid
print("Price_AV NOT in Details:", len(not_in_details))
print("Price_AV NOT in Mesh:", len(not_in_mesh))
print("Price_AV NOT in (Details e Mesh):", len(not_in_details & not_in_mesh))

cover = pd.DataFrame({
    "listing em Price": pd.Series(list(pid)),
})
cover["em_details"] = cover["listing em Price"].isin(did)
cover["em_mesh"] = cover["listing em Price"].isin(mid)
cover.to_csv(OUT / "audit_price_ids_coverage.csv", index=False)

# cobertura por bairro / quartos / tipo (usando Mesh p/ bairro, Details p/ qtos e tipo)
px = price[["airbnb_listing_id"]].drop_duplicates()
px = px.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
px = px.merge(details[["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
              on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
px["has_price"] = 1
cov = px.groupby("suburb")["has_price"].agg(["size", "sum"])
cov["frac"] = cov["sum"] / cov["size"]
cov_name = cov.reset_index().rename(columns={"size": "n_listings", "sum": "n_com_preco"})
cov_name.to_csv(OUT / "audit_coverage_by_suburb.csv", index=False)
print("cobertura por bairro (top20):")
print(cov.sort_values("size", ascending=False).head(20))

for grp_col in ["number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]:
    _g = px.groupby(grp_col)["has_price"].agg(["size", "sum"])
    _g["frac"] = _g["sum"] / _g["size"]
    print(f"cobertura por {grp_col}:")
    print(_g)

# ---------------- 3. HOSTS JOIN RISK ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("3. HOSTS - RISCO DE JOIN")
n_host_lines, n_host_uniq = len(hosts), hosts["owner_id"].nunique()
print("linhas Hosts:", n_host_lines, "| owner_id unicos:", n_host_uniq)
freq = hosts["owner_id"].value_counts()
print("max aparencias de um owner_id:", freq.max())
print(freq.value_counts().sort_index().rename("n_owners").head(20))
freq.reset_index().rename(columns={"owner_id": "owner_id", "count": "n_linhas"})\
    .to_csv(OUT / "audit_hosts_freq.csv", index=False)

# simular join de Details x Hosts por owner_id
J = details.merge(hosts, on="owner_id", how="left")
print("linhas Details:", len(details), "| apos join com Hosts:", len(J))
# hosts x details
H = hosts.merge(details, on="owner_id", how="inner")
print("linhas se joinar Hosts(D) a Details:", len(H))

# campos que variam dentro do mesmo owner_id
grp_by_owner = hosts.groupby("owner_id")
var_fields = {}
for col in hosts.columns:
    if col == "owner_id":
        continue
    try:
        nuniq = grp_by_owner[col].nunique()
    except Exception:
        continue
    var_fields[col] = nuniq.max()
var_df = pd.DataFrame(list(var_fields.items()), columns=["campo", "max_distintos_por_owner"])
print("max valores distintos de cada campo dentro de owner_id:")
print(var_df)
var_df.to_csv(OUT / "audit_hosts_var_by_owner.csv", index=False)

# regra: snapshot mais recente por owner
hosts_sorted = hosts.sort_values("host_snapshot_date")
hosts_latest = hosts_sorted.drop_duplicates("owner_id", keep="last")
print("\nHosts apos dedup por snapshot mais recente:", len(hosts_latest), "(esperado", num_host_uniq, ")")
hosts_latest.to_csv(OUT / "audit_hosts_latest_per_owner.csv", index=False)

"""
Auditoria inicial dos 5 datasets. Reproduz├¡vel, apenas leitura de data/.
N├úo modifica data/. N├úo calcula receita. N├úo assume ocupa├º├úo externa.
Gera artefatos em outputs/tables/.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 100)


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"   saved -> {OUT / name}")


def load(fname: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA / fname, encoding="utf-8", low_memory=False)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    return df


def parse_data(df: pd.DataFrame, cols: list) -> None:
    for c in cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_datetime(df[c], errors="coerce")


print("=" * 72); print("CARREGANDO")
details = load("Details_Itapema.csv")
hosts = load("Hosts_ids_Itapema.csv")
mesh = load("Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv")
price = load("Price_AV_Itapema.csv")
vr = load("VivaReal_Itapema.csv")
parse_data(details, ["aquisition_date"])
parse_data(hosts, ["host_snapshot_date"])
parse_data(mesh, ["aquisition_date"])
parse_data(price, ["aquisition_date", "date"])
parse_data(vr, ["aquisition_date"])

for df_, c in [(details, "airbnb_listing_id"), (mesh, "airbnb_listing_id"),
               (price, "airbnb_listing_id"), (hosts, "owner_id"),
               (details, "owner_id")]:
    df_[c] = df_[c].astype(str).str.strip()

# ---------------- 1. PRICE_AV GRANULARIDADE ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("1. PRICE_AV - GRANULARIDADE")
price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
price["stay"] = price["date"].dt.normalize()
print("capture_day distintos (ignora hora):", price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique())
print("value_counts por capture_day:")
print(price["capture_day"].value_counts().sort_index())

price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
lead_by_day = (price.dropna(subset=["capture_day", "lead"])
               .groupby("capture_day")["lead"]
               .agg(["min", "max", "nunique", "count"]))
print("lead por capture_day (min/max/diasDistintos/nLinhas):")
print(lead_by_day)
save(lead_by_day.reset_index(), "audit_price_lead_by_capture_day.csv")

price["d90"] = price["capture_day"] + pd.Timedelta(days=90)
price["in_d90"] = (price["stay"] >= price["capture_day"]) & (price["stay"] <= price["d90"])
print("\nfrac linhas dentro de [capture, capture+90]:", round(price["in_d90"].mean(), 4))

key = ["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day", "stay"]
dups = price.duplicated(subset=key, keep=False)
print("linhas duplicadas por (listing, capture_day, stay):", int(dups.sum()))
save(price[dups].sort_values(key + ["aquisition_date"]), "audit_price_duplicates.csv")

grp = price.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"])["aquisition_date"]
ts_count = grp.nunique().rename("ts_distintos")
print("\ndistribuicao de timestamps distintos por (listing, capture_day):")
print(ts_count.value_counts().sort_index())

mts = ts_count[ts_count >= 2]
print("\npares (listing, capture_day) com >=2 timestamps:", len(mts))
if len(mts):
    ex = price.sort_values(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day", "aquisition_date"])
    ex = ex[ex.set_index(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).index.isin(mts.index)]
    ex = ex.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"]).agg(
        n_ts=("aquisition_date", "nunique"),
        stay_min=("stay", "min"),
        stay_max=("stay", "max"),
        n_stays=("stay", "nunique"),
    ).head(20)
    print(ex)
    save(ex.reset_index(), "audit_price_multi_timestamp_examples.csv")
else:
    print("nenhum exemplo.")

# ---------------- 2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("2. COBERTURA PRICE_AV")
pid = set(price["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
did = set(details["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
mid = set(mesh["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
print("IDs Price_AV:", len(pid))
print("Price_AV INTER Details:", len(pid & did))
print("Price_AV INTER Mesh:", len(pid & mid))
print("Price_AV NOT em Details:", len(pid - did))
print("Price_AV NOT em Mesh:", len(pid - mid))
print("Price_AV NOT em (Details e Mesh):", len(pid - did - mid))

px = price[["airbnb_listing_id"]].drop_duplicates()
px = px.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
px = px.merge(details[["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
              on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
px["has_price"] = 1
for grp_col in ["suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]:
    g = px.groupby(grp_col)["has_price"].agg(["size", "sum"])
    g["frac"] = g["sum"] / g["size"]
    print(f"\ncobertura por {grp_col} (top por n):")
    print(g.sort_values("size", ascending=False).head(20))
    save(g.reset_index(), f"audit_coverage_by_{grp_col}.csv")

# ---------------- 3. HOSTS JOIN RISK ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("3. HOSTS - RISCO DE JOIN")
n_host_lines = len(hosts)
n_host_uniq = hosts["owner_id"].nunique()
print("linhas Hosts:", n_host_lines, "| owner_id unicos:", n_host_uniq)
freq = hosts["owner_id"].value_counts()
print("max aparencias de um owner_id:", freq.max())
print("count de owners por numero de linhas:")
print(freq.value_counts().sort_index().rename("n_owners"))
save(freq.reset_index().rename(columns={"owner_id": "owner_id", "count": "n_linhas"}),
     "audit_hosts_freq.csv")

J = details.merge(hosts, on="owner_id", how="left")
print("\nlinhas Details:", len(details), "| apos mergo Details x Hosts (how=left):", len(J))
inner = details.merge(hosts, on="owner_id", how="inner")
print("linhas se joinar (inner) Details x Hosts:", len(inner))

var_fields = {}
for col in hosts.columns:
    if col == "owner_id":
        continue
    try:
        var_fields[col] = hosts.groupby("owner_id")[col].nunique().max()
    except Exception:
        pass
var_df = pd.DataFrame(list(var_fields.items()), columns=["campo", "max_distintos_por_owner"])
print("\nmax valores distintos por campo dentro de um owner_id:")
print(var_df)
save(var_df, "audit_hosts_var_by_owner.csv")

hosts_sorted = hosts.sort_values("host_snapshot_date")
hosts_latest = hosts_sorted.drop_duplicates("owner_id", keep="last")
print("\nHosts dedup por snapshot mais recente:", len(hosts_latest), "(esperado =", n_host_uniq, ")")
save(hosts_latest, "audit_hosts_latest_per_owner.csv")

# ---------------- 4. TESE DOS COMPACTOS ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("4. TESE DOS COMPACTOS (somente amostra)")
det = details[["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms"]].copy()
det["bedrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(det["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce").fillna(-1)
det["tipo"] = details["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
dc = det.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
dc["bc"] = dc["suburb"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
has_price = dc["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(price["airbnb_listing_id"])

studio = dc["bedrooms"] == 0
one_bed = dc["bedrooms"] == 1
centro = dc["bc"] == "centro"
apto = dc["tipo"] == "apartamento"

def show(mask, label):
    n = int(mask.sum())
    np_ = int((mask & has_price).sum())
    print(f"  {label}: n={n}  com Price_AV={np_} (frac={(np_/n) if n else 0:.3f})")

show(study & centro, "studio (br==0) + centro")
show(one_bed & centro, "1 quarto + centro")
show(one_bed & centro & apto, "apartamento + 1 quarto + centro")

# ---------------- 5. RATINGS ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("5. RATINGS (zero vs sem reviews)")
ct = pd.crosstab(details["number_of_reviews"] == 0, details["star_rating"] == 0)
print("Details: linhas=>star==0? col=>nrev==0?")
print(ct)
save(ct.reset_index(), "audit_ratings_zero_vs_reviews.csv")

cth = pd.crosstab(hosts["number_of_reviews_host"].fillna(-1) == 0, hosts["star_rating_host"] == 0)
print("Hosts: cruzando star_rating_host==0 x number_of_reviews_host==0:")
print(cth)
save(cth.reset_index(), "audit_ratings_host_zero_vs_reviews.csv")

# ---------------- 6. VIVAREAL ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("6. VIVAREAL")
print("linhas:", len(vr), "| listing_id unicos:", vr["listing_id"].nunique())
print("duplicatas exatas (todas colunas):", int(vr.duplicated(keep=False).sum()))
print("listing_id repetidos:", int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()))

def missing_report(df, cols):
    rec = []
    for c in cols:
        s = df[c]
        na = int(s.isna().sum())
        blank = int(s.astype(str).str.strip().isin(["", "<NA>", "nan", "None"]).sum())
        rec.append({"col": c, "missing_na": na, "blank": blank})
    return pd.DataFrame(rec)

miss = missing_report(vr, ["sale_price", "yearly_iptu", "monthly_condo_fee",
                           "rental_price", "usable_area", "bedrooms"])
print(miss)
save(miss, "audit_vivareal_missing.csv")

for col in ["sale_price", "usable_area"]:
    num = pd.to_numeric(vr[col], errors="coerce")
    print(f"\n--- {col} (n={int(num.notna().sum())}):")
    print(num.describe().round(2))
    print("top10 maior:")
    print(num.dropna().nlargest(10).to_list())

vr["suburb_original"] = vr["suburb"]
vr["suburb_norm"] = vr["suburb"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
print("\nbusiness_types:", vr["business_types"].value_counts().to_dict())
save(vr[["listing_id", "suburb_original", "suburb_norm", "sale_price", "bedrooms"]],
     "audit_vivareal_normalized.csv")

# ---------------- 7. HIPOTESE PRICE/VIVAREAL ----------------
print("=" * 72); print("7. PRICE_AV: preco apresentado para data disponivel?")
n_past = int((price["stay"] < price["capture_day"]).sum())
print("linhas com estadia ANTES da captura:", n_past)

print("frac lead in [0,90]:", round(price["lead"].between(0, 90).mean(), 4))
print("mean n stays distintos por (listing, capture_day):",
      round(price.groupby(["airbnb_listing_id", "capture_day"])["stay"].nunique().mean(), 2))

print("\nOK")

So "suburb" group counts only price listings. has_price=1 always. So frac is always 1.0. That's a bug - it doesn't measure coverage (fraction of ALL listings in that suburb that have prices). It's tautological.

The intention: coverage by suburb = of all listings (Details Ôê® Mesh) in that suburb, how many have price. I need to base the denominator on all listings (mesh with details), not just price listings.

Let me fix the coverage computation. Base = details merged with mesh (all listings), then has_price = in price ids.

===================================================================
--- src/02_airbnb_metrics.py	
+++ src/02_airbnb_metrics.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,336 @@
+"""
+M├®tricas de performance Airbnb (PROXY). Snapshot principal 20/01/2025.
+
+Interpreta Price_AV como calend├írio de PRE├çOS DISPON├ìVEIS:
+  - linha existente                       => data dispon├¡vel com pre├ºo anunciado;
+  - stay ausente na janela D..D+90        => INDISPON├ìVEL (proxy);
+  - indispon├¡vel N├âO = reserva (bloqueio/manuten├º├úo/uso propriet├írio);
+  - listing ausente do Price_AV           => estado desconhecido (n├úo 100% indispon├¡vel).
+
+FAZ: ADR/unavailability/rev proxies, pickup, painel, segmentos, tese, robustez.
+N├âO faz: VivaReal, ROI, anualiza├º├úo, ML, escolha de im├│vel, altera├º├úo de data/.
+Todas as m├®tricas s├úo PROXY; nunca receita/ocupa├º├úo realizadas.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+PD = pd.Timestamp
+MAIN_DAY = PD("2025-01-20")
+D06 = PD("2025-01-06")
+D07 = PD("2025-01-07")
+DAYS = [D06, D07, MAIN_DAY]
+HORIZONS = [30, 60, 91]
+
+
+def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
+    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
+    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")
+
+
+# ---------------- carga ----------------
+details = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Details_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str, "owner_id": str})
+mesh = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
+price = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Price_AV_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
+price["aquisition_date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["aquisition_date"], errors="coerce")
+price["date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["date"], errors="coerce")
+price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
+price["stay"] = price["date"].dt.normalize()
+price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
+price["price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(price["price"], errors="coerce")
+
+# ---------------- repro: propriedades (com assertions) ----------------
+print("=" * 76)
+print("REPRO ÔÇö propriedades Price_AV")
+assert price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique() == 3, "capturas != 3 dias"
+for d in DAYS:
+    s = price[price["capture_day"] == d]
+    assert s["lead"].between(0, 90).all(), f"lead fora de [0,90] em {d}"
+    assert not s.duplicated(subset=["airbnb_listing_id", "stay"]).any(), f"dup (listing,stay) em {d}"
+print("  OK: 3 capturas; lead sempre em [0,90]; sem duplicata (listing,stay) por captura.")
+
+caps = {d: set(price.loc[price["capture_day"] == d, "airbnb_listing_id"].unique()) for d in DAYS}
+print("  listings por captura:", {d.strftime('%m-%d'): len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS})
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas por listing no 20/01
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas no 20/01 (horizontes 30/60/91)")
+
+main = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY].copy()
+rows = []
+for lid, sub in main.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
+    for H in HORIZONS:
+        s = sub[(sub["lead"] >= 0) & (sub["lead"] < H)]
+        avail = len(s)
+        unavail = H - avail
+        rate = unavail / H
+        pr = s["price_num"].dropna()
+        n_price = int(len(pr))
+        if n_price:
+            med = float(pr.median()); mean = float(pr.mean())
+            p25 = float(pr.quantile(0.25)); p75 = float(pr.quantile(0.75))
+        else:
+            med = mean = p25 = p75 = np.nan
+        rev_pn = med * rate if n_price else np.nan
+        rows.append({
+            "airbnb_listing_id": lid, "horizon": H,
+            "available_nights_H": avail, "unavailable_nights_H": unavail,
+            "unavailability_rate_H": rate,
+            "median_available_price_H": med, "mean_available_price_H": mean,
+            "p25_price_H": p25, "p75_price_H": p75,
+            "n_prices_observed_H": n_price,
+            "revenue_proxy_per_night_H": rev_pn, "gross_revenue_proxy_H": rev_pn * H,
+        })
+metrics = pd.DataFrame(rows)
+price_any = main.groupby("airbnb_listing_id")["price_num"].agg(lambda v: int(v.notna().any()))
+metrics["is_in_price_av"] = metrics["airbnb_listing_id"].map(lambda i: int(i in caps[MAIN_DAY]))
+metrics["has_price_in_horizon"] = metrics["n_prices_observed_H"] > 0
+metrics["flag_no_price_in_horizon"] = metrics["is_in_price_av"].astype(bool) & ~metrics["has_price_in_horizon"]
+
+# wide: 1 linha por listing, horizontes como colunas
+m_piv = metrics.pivot_table(index="airbnb_listing_id", columns="horizon",
+                            values=["available_nights_H", "unavailable_nights_H",
+                                    "unavailability_rate_H", "median_available_price_H",
+                                    "mean_available_price_H", "p25_price_H", "p75_price_H",
+                                    "n_prices_observed_H", "revenue_proxy_per_night_H",
+                                    "gross_revenue_proxy_H"],
+                            aggfunc="first")
+m_piv.columns = [f"{v}_{int(k)}" for v, k in m_piv.columns]
+save(m_piv.reset_index(), "listing_metrics_wide.csv")
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 4 ÔÇö master (Details + Mesh + m├®tricas 30/60/91)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 4 ÔÇö tabela mestre")
+
+cols_det = ["airbnb_listing_id", "number_of_bedrooms", "number_of_bathrooms",
+            "number_of_guests", "number_of_beds", "number_of_reviews",
+            "star_rating", "guest_satisfaction_overall", "cleaning_fee",
+            "is_guest_favorite", "can_instant_book", "is_professional", "listing_type"]
+master = details[cols_det].merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]],
+                                 on="airbnb_listing_id", how="inner")
+assert master["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "master n├úo 1:1"
+
+numc = ["number_of_bedrooms", "number_of_bathrooms", "number_of_guests",
+        "number_of_beds", "number_of_reviews", "cleaning_fee", "star_rating"]
+for c in numc:
+    master[c] = pd.to_numeric(master[c], errors="coerce")
+
+master["star_rating_original"] = master["star_rating"]
+master["star_rating_clean"] = np.where(
+    (master["star_rating"].fillna(-1) == 0) & (master["number_of_reviews"].fillna(-1) == 0),
+    np.nan, master["star_rating"])
+
+master = master.merge(m_piv, on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
+master["is_in_price_av"] = master["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(caps[MAIN_DAY])
+master["is_balanced_panel"] = master["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(
+    caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY])
+save(master, "listing_metrics.csv")
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 3 ÔÇö painel balanceado
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 3 ÔÇö painel balanceado (interse├º├úo dos 3)")
+inter_3 = caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]
+bal = pd.DataFrame({
+    "dia": [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in DAYS],
+    "n_listings": [len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS],
+})
+bal.loc[len(bal)] = ["intersecao_3_snapshots", len(inter_3)]
+save(bal, "balanced_panel.csv")
+print("  N painel balanceado (em todos os 3):", len(inter_3))
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 2 ÔÇö booking-pickup proxy (06/01 vs 20/01)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 2 ÔÇö booking-pickup proxy (06/01 -> 20/01)")
+
+# janela comum: [20/01, 06/01+90] = [2025-01-20, 2025-04-06]
+common_start = MAIN_DAY
+common_end = D06 + pd.Timedelta(days=90)  # 2025-04-06
+common_dates = pd.date_range(common_start, common_end, freq="D")
+print("  janela comum:", common_start.date(), "a", common_end.date(),
+      "(", len(common_dates), "datas )")
+
+a06 = price[price["capture_day"] == D06].copy()
+a20 = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY].copy()
+only06 = set(a06[a06["stay"].isin(common_dates)]["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
+only20 = set(a20[a20["stay"].isin(common_dates)]["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
+both = only06 & only20
+print("  listings nas duas capturas (janela comum):", len(both))
+
+pick = []
+for lid in both:
+    s06 = a06[(a06["airbnb_listing_id"] == lid) & (a06["stay"].isin(common_dates))]
+    s20 = a20[(a20["airbnb_listing_id"] == lid) & (a20["stay"].isin(common_dates))]
+    s060 = set(s06["stay"]); s200 = set(s20["stay"])
+    a2u = len(s060 - s200)   # presentes 06, ausentes 20
+    u2a = len(s200 - s060)   # ausentes 06, presentes 20
+    # pickup value: preco em 06 da noite que sumiu
+    pv = s06.loc[s06["stay"].isin(s060 - s200), "price_num"].sum()
+    rv = s20.loc[s20["stay"].isin(s200 - s060), "price_num"].sum()
+    pick.append({
+        "airbnb_listing_id": lid,
+        "available_to_unavailable_nights": a2u,
+        "unavailable_to_available_nights": u2a,
+        "net_unavailability_pickup": a2u - u2a,
+        "pickup_value_proxy": pv,
+        "release_value_proxy": rv,
+        "net_pickup_value_proxy": pv - rv,
+        "PROXY": True,
+    })
+pick_df = pd.DataFrame(pick)
+save(pick_df, "pickup_metrics.csv")
+print("  pickup_metrics linhas:", len(pick_df))
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 5 ÔÇö segmentos (usando 20/01, horizonte 91)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 5 ÔÇö segmentos (20/01, H=91)")
+
+H = 91
+segbase = metrics[metrics["horizon"] == H].copy()
+seg = segbase.merge(master[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
+                    on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
+
+
+def seg_table(df, group_cols):
+    df = df.copy()
+    for c in group_cols:
+        df[c] = df[c].apply(lambda v: "Missing/Unknown"
+                            if (v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v))) else v)
+    out = []
+    for keys, g in df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
+        n = len(g)
+        if isinstance(keys, tuple):
+            key = keys
+        else:
+            key = (keys,)
+        adr = g["median_available_price_H"].dropna()
+        unv = g["unavailability_rate_H"].fillna(0).dropna()
+        rev = g["gross_revenue_proxy_H"].dropna()
+        rec = {"N_listings": n}
+        for k, colname in zip(group_cols, key):
+            rec[k] = colname
+        for label, series in [("ADR", adr), ("unavailability", unv), ("rev_proxy", rev)]:
+            rec[f"{label}_median"] = series.median() if len(series) else np.nan
+            rec[f"{label}_mean"] = series.mean() if len(series) else np.nan
+            rec[f"{label}_p25"] = series.quantile(0.25) if len(series) else np.nan
+            rec[f"{label}_p75"] = series.quantile(0.75) if len(series) else np.nan
+        if n < 5:
+            conf = "muito_baixa"
+        elif n < 20:
+            conf = "baixa"
+        elif n < 50:
+            conf = "media"
+        else:
+            conf = "alta"
+        rec["confianca_amostral"] = conf
+        out.append(rec)
+    return pd.DataFrame(out)
+
+
+save(seg_table(seg, ["suburb"]), "segment_by_suburb.csv")
+save(seg_table(seg, ["number_of_bedrooms"]), "segment_by_bedrooms.csv")
+save(seg_table(seg, ["listing_type"]), "segment_by_listing_type.csv")
+save(seg_table(seg, ["suburb", "number_of_bedrooms"]), "segment_suburb_bedrooms.csv")
+save(seg_table(seg, ["suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]), "segment_full.csv")
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 6 ÔÇö tese interna (est├║dio/1quarto/centro)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 6 ÔÇö tese dos compactos (evid├¬ncia, n├úo veredicto)")
+
+
+def bairro_clean(s):
+    s = str(s).strip().lower()
+    return s
+
+
+master["suburb_low"] = master["suburb"].map(bairro_clean)
+master["tipo_low"] = master["listing_type"].astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
+BR0 = pd.to_numeric(master["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce") == 0
+BR1 = pd.to_numeric(master["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce") == 1
+CENTRO = master["suburb_low"] == "centro"
+APTO = master["tipo_low"] == "apartamento"
+
+master["is_balance"] = master["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(inter_3)
+thesis_rows = []
+for mask_name, mask in [("studio+Centro", BR0 & CENTRO),
+                        ("1quarto+Centro", BR1 & CENTRO),
+                        ("apart+1quarto+Centro", APTO & BR1 & CENTRO)]:
+    sub = master[mask]
+    n_det = len(sub)
+    n_price = int(sub["is_in_price_av"].sum())
+    n_snap = int(sub["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(caps[MAIN_DAY]).sum())
+    withprice = sub[sub["is_in_price_av"]]
+    adr_91 = withprice["median_available_price_H_91"].median() if "median_available_price_H_91" in withprice.columns else np.nan
+    unv_91 = withprice["unavailability_rate_H_91"].median() if "unavailability_rate_H_91" in withprice.columns else np.nan
+    rev_91 = withprice["gross_revenue_proxy_H_91"].median() if "gross_revenue_proxy_H_91" in withprice.columns else np.nan
+    thesis_rows.append({
+        "perfil": mask_name, "N_details": n_det, "N_com_price": n_price,
+        "N_snapshot_20jan": n_snap,
+        "ADR_median_91": adr_91, "unavail_rate_median_91": unv_91,
+        "gross_rev_proxy_median_91": rev_91,
+    })
+thesis = pd.DataFrame(thesis_rows)
+# classifica├º├úo
+def classify(r):
+    if r["N_details"] < 5 or r["N_com_price"] < 5:
+        return "evid├¬ncia insuficiente"
+    return "amostra suficiente (a avaliar adiante)"
+thesis["classificacao"] = thesis.apply(classify, axis=1)
+save(thesis, "compact_thesis.csv")
+print(thesis)
+
+# ============================================================
+# OBJETIVO 7 ÔÇö robustez: rankings 06/07 vs 20 (n├úo misturar)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 76)
+print("OBJETIVO 7 ÔÇö robustez de ranking entre snapshots (H=91)")
+
+rob_rows = []
+for d in DAYS:
+    sub_p = price[price["capture_day"] == d]
+    mm = {}
+    for lid, sg in sub_p.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
+        s = sg[(sg["lead"] >= 0) & (sg["lead"] < 91)]
+        pr = s["price_num"].dropna()
+        mm[lid] = {"ADR": pr.median() if len(pr) else np.nan,
+                   "unav": (91 - len(s)) / 91,
+                   "rev": (pr.median() * (91 - len(s)) / 91 * 91) if len(pr) else np.nan}
+    rt = pd.DataFrame(mm).T.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "airbnb_listing_id"})
+    rt = rt.merge(master[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
+                  on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
+    rt["suburb_low"] = rt["suburb"].apply(lambda v: "Missing/Unknown"
+                                          if (v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v)))
+                                          else str(v).strip().lower())
+    rt["tipo_low"] = rt["listing_type"].astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
+    sub_r = rt.groupby("suburb_low")["ADR"].agg(["median", "count"]).reset_index()
+    sub_r.columns = ["suburb_low", "ADR_median", "N_listings"]
+    sub_r["snapshot"] = d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    rob_rows.append(sub_r)
+robust = pd.concat(rob_rows, ignore_index=True)
+save(robust, "snapshot_robustness.csv")
+
+for d in DAYS:
+    g = robust[robust["snapshot"] == d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")].sort_values("ADR_median", ascending=False).head(5)
+    print(f"  top5 bairro por ADR ({d:%m-%d}) [N]  (N<5 = cuidado):")
+    for _, r in g.iterrows():
+        flag = " (*poucos)" if r["N_listings"] < 5 else ""
+        print(f"     {r['suburb_low']:>22}: ADR {r['ADR_median']:.0f}  [N={int(r['N_listings'])}]{flag}")
+
+print("\nDONE")
\ No newline at end of file

"""
M├®tricas de performance Airbnb (PROXY). Snapshot principal 20/01/2025.
Interpreta Price_AV como calend├írio de PRE├çOS DISPON├ìVEIS:
  - linha existente  = data dispon├¡vel com pre├ºo anunciado;
  - stay ausente dentro da janela D..D+90 do capture dia  => INDISPON├ìVEL (proxy);
  - indispon├¡vel N├âO = reserva (pode ser bloqueio/manuten├º├úo/uso do propriet├írio);
  - listing totalmente ausente do Price_AV => estado desconhecido (n├úo 100% indispon├¡vel).

FAZ: adr/unavailability/revenue proxies, pickup proxy, painel, segmentos, tese.
N├âO faz: VivaReal, ROI, anualiza├º├úo, ML, escolha de im├│vel, altera├º├úo de data/.
Todas as m├®tricas s├úo proxies, nunca receita/ocupa├º├úo reais.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

HORIZONS = {30: 30, 60: 60, 91: 91}  # H dias, lead 0..H-1

# ---------------- carga (mesma conven├º├úo da auditoria) ----------------
dtype = {"airbnb_listing_id": str, "owner_id": str, "listing_id": str}
details = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Details_Itapema.csv", dtype=dtype)
mesh = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv", dtype=dtype)
price = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Price_AV_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
price["aquisition_date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["aquisition_date"], errors="coerce")
price["date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["date"], errors="coerce")
price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
price["stay"] = price["date"].dt.normalize()
price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
price["price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(price["price"], errors="coerce")

MAIN_DAY = pd.Timestamp("2025-01-20")
P90 = MAIN_DAY + pd.Timedelta(days=90)


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")


def px(x):
    return np.nanmedian if x.dtype.kind in "fi" else (lambda v: np.median(v[~np.isnan(v)]))
# not used; keep simple medians via pandas below

print("=" * 76)
print("single-line REPRO VALIDATION")
main = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY]
assert main["stay"].between(MAIN_DAY, MAIN_DAY + pd.Timedelta(days=90)).all(), "lead fora de [0,90]"
assert not main.duplicated(subset=["airbnb_listing_id", "stay"]).any(), "dup (listing, stay) no 20/01"
print("  sobre 20/01: todos lead em [0,90]; sem dup (listing, stay).")

# Unique listing ids per capture, set for pickup & panel
capids = {k: set(price[price["capture_day"] == k]["airbnb_listing_id"].unique())
          for k in [pd.Timestamp("2025-01-06"), pd.Timestamp("2025-01-07"), MAIN_DAY]}
print("20/01 listings:", len(capids[MAIN_DAY]),
      "| 06/01:", len(capids[pd.Timestamp("2025-01-06")]),
      "| 07/01:", len(capids[pd.Timestamp("2025-01-07")]))

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö SNAPSHOT PRINCIPAL (20/01): metricas por listing
# ============================================================
print("=" * 76)
print("OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas por listing no snapshot 20/01 (horizontes 30/60/91)")

M = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY].copy()
row = []
for lid, sub in M.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
    for H in HORIZONS:

Quanto maior H, maior a fra├º├úo indisponibilidade relativa **cai** (a janela curta tende a "ocupar" os primeiros 30 dias ÔÇö alta temporada mais vendida) e o numero de listings cobertos sobe. **H=30 tem vi├®s de janela curta e menos cobertura**; H=91 ├® mais est├ível. Recomendo H=91 como principal (e n├úo anualiza├º├úo).

## G. O pickup temporal contra a ranking do snapshot?
- **Snapshot (20/01)**: Meia Praia (rev 19.2k) > Centro (13.2k) > Morretes.
- **Pickup (06ÔåÆ20, net_value_proxy)**: Meia Praia = **R$1,65M** > Centro = **R$603k** > Morretes = R$117k. ÔåÆ **Ordena por valor absoluto dominale o volume (n alta)**; mas a **ordem de bairros ├® a mesma do snapshot**. `AvailableÔåÆunavailable` (Meia Praia 2.694 noites vs Centro 1.209) confirma que quem tinha maior receita tamb├®m "consome" mais disponibilidade.
- **Contradi├º├úo/aten├º├úo**: em termos per-listing, o pickup ├® dominado por volume (bairros com muito mais listings somam mais),n├úo por desempenho por unidade. Distinguish entre `net_value_proxy` absoluto (volume) e por-listing (intensidade) ├® necess├írio; o fato de **Centro ter menor unavailability (0.31)** e pickup positivo p├┤r ait mesmo n├úo coloc├í-lo acima de Meia Praia em ADR indica que **Meia Praia, n├úo Centro, ├® o bairro de maior receita/consumo de disponibilidade**.

## H. Limita├º├Áes
1. Tudo ├® **proxy**: linha existente = dispon├¡vel; ausente na janela = indispon├¡vel **Ôëá reserva** (bloqueios, uso do propriet├írio, manuten├º├úo). Semantic difere.
2. **Cobertura enviesada**: s├│ ~22% dos listings t├¬m pre├ºo; apartamentos/hoteis de luxo sub-representados, hotel quase sem pre├ºo.
3. **Sem custo de aquisi├º├úo/├írea** (VivaReal n├úo usado ainda) ÔåÆ **n├úo d├í para concluir retorno/efici├¬ncia**, apenas receita bruta proxy de demanda.
4. Listings ausentes do Price_AV = estado desconhecido (n├úo tratei como 100% indispon├¡vel).
5. ADR com N<5 (Sertaozinho, Areal etc.) n├úo deve ser interpretado como ranking de bairro real.
6. **Horizonte curto (JAnÔÇôAbr, Jan tem Carnaval/ver├úo)**: seazonalidade n├úo estim├ível; n├úo anualize o resultado pretendido.
7. N├úo h├í controle para centro Magn├®tico/decora├º├úo/texto: listing_type='outros'.
8. pickup n├úo distingue volume vs intensidade; indicadores devem ler `net_pickup_value` como absoluto, n├úo por-unidade.

**Achados que contradizem a tese interna** (e que aponto em vez de justificar): a proposta de "studio/1q no Centro como mais eficiente" **n├úo ├® suportada em termos de receita bruta proxy ou ADR** ÔÇö o studio-Centro mal existe (n=3), e o 1q-Centro tem ADR abaixo de Meia Praia e de im├│veis maiores. A defesa, se houver, teria que vir pelo **custo** (VivaReal), que ainda n├úo analisamos.

Quer que eu prossiga para `src/03_` integrando VivaReal (custo de aquisi├º├úo, ├írea, retorno por unidade) para responder ├á "efici├¬ncia/retorno" que a receita bruta sozinha n├úo responde?

"""
M├®tricas de performance Airbnb ÔÇö PROXY. Snapshot principal 20/01/2025.

Decis├úo metodol├│gica (Price_AV = calend├írio de PRE├çOS DISPON├ìVEIS):
  - linha existente  => data dispon├¡vel com pre├ºo anunciado;
  - aus├¬ncia de stay dentro da janela D..D+90 do capture => INDISPON├ìVEL (proxy);
  - indisponibilidade N├âO = reserva (pode ser bloqueio/manuten├º├úo/uso do propriet├írio);
  - listing totalmente ausente do Price_AV => estado desconhecido (n├úo 100% indispon├¡vel).

Nesta vers├úo (revis├úo final):
  - static revenue proxy_H = median_available_price_H ├ù unavailable_nights_H
      (pressup├Áe que a mediana do pre├ºo das noites ainda dispon├¡veis aproxima o valor
       das noites indispon├¡veis). NUNCA ├® receita observada.
  - pickup = segunda evid├¬ncia independente e temporal, nunca "reservas".

FAZ: proxies por listing/horizonte, pickup normalizado, painel balanceado,
     segmentos, tese, robustez entre snapshots.
N├âO faz: VivaReal, ROI, anualiza├º├úo, ML, escolha de im├│vel, altera├º├úo de data/.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

PD = pd.Timestamp
MAIN_DAY = PD("2025-01-20")
D06 = PD("2025-01-06")
D07 = PD("2025-01-07")
DAYS = [D06, D07, MAIN_DAY]
HORIZONS = [30, 60, 91]
COMMON_START = MAIN_DAY
COMMON_END = D06 + pd.Timedelta(days=90)
COMMON_DATES = pd.date_range(COMMON_START, COMMON_END, freq="D")


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")


def norma(val):
    return "Missing/Unknown" if (val is None or (isinstance(val, float) and pd.isna(val))) else val


# ---------------- carga (mesmas conven├º├Áes da auditoria) ----------------
details = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Details_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str, "owner_id": str})
mesh = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
price = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Price_AV_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
price["aquisition_date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["aquisition_date"], errors="coerce")
price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
price["stay"] = pd.to_datetime(price["date"], errors="coerce").dt.normalize()
price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
price["price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(price["price"], errors="coerce")

# ---------------- repro: propriedades (assertions) ----------------
print("=" * 78)
print("REPRO ÔÇö PROPRIEDADES Price_AV")
assert price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique() == 3, "captures != 3"
for d in DAYS:
    s = price[price["capture_day"] == d]
    assert s["lead"].between(0, 90).all(), f"lead fora de [0,90] em {d:%Y-%m-%d}"
    assert not s.duplicated(subset=["airbnb_listing_id", "stay"]).any(), f"dup (listing,stay) em {d:%Y-%m-%d}"
caps = {d: set(price.loc[price["capture_day"] == d, "airbnb_listing_id"].unique()) for d in DAYS}
print("  listings por capture:", {d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"): len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS})
print("  interse├º├úo 06├ù20 (conjunto):", len(caps[D06] & caps[MAIN_DAY]),
      "| interse├º├úo 3:", len(caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]))

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas por listing/horizonte (20/01)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas por listing no 20/01 (H=30,60,91)")
main = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY].copy()
snapshot_listings = caps[MAIN_DAY]

rows = []
for lid, sub in main.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
    for H in HORIZONS:
        s = sub[(sub["lead"] >= 0) & (sub["lead"] < H)]
        avail = len(s)
        unavail = H - avail
        rate = unavail / H
        pr = s["price_num"].dropna()
        n_price = int(len(pr))
        med = float(pr.median()) if n_price else np.nan
        mean = float(pr.mean()) if n_price else np.nan
        p25 = float(pr.quantile(0.25)) if n_price else np.nan
        p75 = float(pr.quantile(0.75)) if n_price else np.nan
        # static revenue proxy (duas escalas, sempre proxy)
        srp_night = med * rate if n_price else np.nan
        srp_total = med * unavail if n_price else np.nan
        rows.append({
            "airbnb_listing_id": lid, "horizon": H,
            "available_nights_H": avail,
            "unavailable_nights_H": unavail,
            "unavailability_rate_H": rate,
            "median_available_price_H": med,
            "mean_available_price_H": mean,
            "p25_price_H": p25, "p75_price_H": p75,
            "n_prices_observed_H": n_price,
            "static_rev_px_per_night_H": srp_night,
            "static_revenue_proxy_H": srp_total,
        })
metrics = pd.DataFrame(rows)
metrics["is_in_price_av_20jan"] = metrics["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(snapshot_list).astype(int)
metrics["has_price_in_horizon"] = (metrics["n_prices_observed_H"] > 0).astype(int)
metrics["flag_no_price_in_horizon"] = (
    (metrics["is_in_price_av_20jan"] == 1) & (metrics["has_price_in_horizon"] == 0)).astype(int)

# wide (1 linha por listing; H como colunas)
W = metrics.pivot_table(index="airbnb_listing_id", columns="horizon",
                        values=["available_nights_H", "unavailable_nights_H",
                                "unavailability_rate_H", "median_available_price_H",
                                "mean_available_price_H", "p25_price_H", "p75_price_H",
                                "n_prices_observed_H",
                                "static_revenue_proxy_H"],
                        aggfunc="first")
W.columns = [f"{v}_{int(k)}" for v, k in W.columns]
# flags em uma linha
flags = metrics[metrics["horizon"] == 91][["airbnb_listing_id", "is_in_price_av_20jan"]].set_index("airbnb_listing_id")
W = W.join(flags["is_in_price_av_20jan"])
for H in HORIZONS:
    W[f"has_price_H_{H}"] = W[f"n_prices_observed_H_{H}"].fillna(0) > 0
    W[f"flag_no_price_H_{H}"] = (W["is_in_price_av_20jan"] == 1) & ~W[f"has_price_H_{H}"]

# ---- relat├│rio de cobertura por horizonte (ponto 4) ----
print("  --- cobertura por horizonte dentro do snapshot 20/01 ---")
snapshot_in_details = snapshot_list & set(details["airbnb_listing_id"])
for H in HORIZONS:
    seg = metrics[metrics["horizon"] == H]
    n_conn = int(snapshot_list & (snapshot_in_details))
    n_with = int((seg["n_prices_observed_H"] > 0).sum())
    n_without = int((seg["n_prices_observed_H"] == 0).sum())
    print(f"   H={H}: snapshot={len(snapshot_list)} conect_update Details={len(snapshot_in_details)} "
          f"| com pre├ºo={n_with} sem pre├ºo={n_without}")
print("  NOTA: um listing pode estar no snapshot sem ter data dispon├¡vel em H "
      "=> sem pre├ºo => static proxy NaN (sem imputa├º├úo, flag levantada).")

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 4 ÔÇö master (Details + Mesh 1:1 + m├®tricas wide)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("OBJETIVO 4 ÔÇö tabela mestre (Details+Mesh, 1:1)")
numc = ["number_of_bedrooms", "number_of_bathrooms", "number_of_guests",
        "number_of_beds", "number_of_reviews", "cleaning_fee", "star_rating"]
det_cols = ["airbnb_listing_id", "listing_type"] + numc
master = details[[c for c in det_cols if c in details.columns]].copy()
master = master.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="inner")
assert master["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "master n├úo ├® 1:1"
for c in numc:
    master[c] = pd.to_numeric(master[c], errors="coerce")
master["star_rating_original"] = master["star_rating"]
master["star_rating_clean"] = np.where(
    (master["star_rating"].fillna(-1) == 0) & (master["number_of_reviews"].fillna(-1) == 0),
    np.nan, master["star_rating"])
master = master.merge(W.reset_index(), on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
master["is_in_price_av_20jan"] = master["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(snapshot_list).astype(int)
master["is_balanced_panel"] = master["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(
    caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]).astype(int)
save(master, "listing_metrics.csv")

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 3 ÔÇö painel balanceado
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("OBJETIVO 3 ÔÇö painel balanceado")
inter3 = caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]
bal_sum = pd.DataFrame({"dia": [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in DAYS],
                        "n_listings": [len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS]})
bal_sum.loc[len(bal_sum)] = ["intersecao_3_snapshots", len(inter3)]
save(bal_sum, "balanced_panel_summary.csv")
bal_ids = pd.DataFrame({"airbnb_listing_id": sorted(inter3)})
save(bal_ids, "balanced_panel.csv")

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 2 ÔÇö booking-pickup PROXY (06/01 -> 20/01)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("OBJETIVO 2 ÔÇö booking-pickup proxy (06/01 ÔåÆ 20/01)")
a06 = price[price["capture_day"] == D06]
a20 = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY]

# universo = presen├ºa em AMBOS os snapshots (n├úo exige linha na janela comum)
universe = caps[D06] & caps[MAIN_DAY]
print(f"  universo pickup = 06Ôê®20 = {len(universe)} listings (janela comum {COMMON_DATES.min().date()} a {COMMON_DATES.max().date()}, {len(COMMON_DATES)} datas)")

def avail_map(df, lid):
    st = set(df.loc[(df["airbnb_listing_id"] == lid) & (df["stay"].isin(COMMON_DATES)), "stay"])
    prices = df.loc[(df["airbnb_listing_id"] == lid) & (df["stay"].isin(COMMON_DATES)), ["stay", "price_num"]]
    return st, prices.set_index("stay")["price_num"]

pick = []
for lid in universe:
    s06, p06 = get_map(a06, lid)
    s20, p20 = get_map(a20, lid)
    a2u = len(s06 - s20)
    u2a = len(s20 - s06)
    net = a2u - u2a
    pv = float(p06.loc[list(s06 - s20)].sum()) if (s06 - s20) else 0.0
    rv = float(p20.loc[list(s20 - s06)].sum()) if (s20 - s06) else 0.0
    nwin = len(COMMON_DATES)
    pick.append({
        "airbnb_listing_id": lid,
        "available_to_unavailable_nights": a2u,
        "unavailable_to_available_nights": u2a,
        "net_unavailability_pickup": net,
        "available_to_unavailable_rate": a2u / nwin,
        "unavailable_to_available_rate": u2a / nwin,
        "net_transition_rate": net / nwin,
        "pickup_value_proxy": pv,
        "release_value_proxy": rv,
        "net_pickup_value_proxy": pv - rv,
        "n_common_dates": nwin,
    })
pick_df = pd.DataFrame(pick)
save(pick_df, "pickup_metrics.csv")

# agrega├º├úo (ponto 6): N, soma, m├®dia, mediana, P25, P75 ÔÇö por bairro
pickw = pick_df.merge(master[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
                      on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
pickw["suburb"] = pickw["suburb"].apply(norma)
pickw["bedr"] = pickw["number_of_bedrooms"].apply(norma)
pickw["typ"] = pickw["listing_type"].apply(norma)

def agg_pick(df, group_cols):
    out = []
    for keys, g in df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        key = keys if isinstance(keys, tuple) else (keys,)
        n = len(g)
        rec = {"N_listings": n}
        for k, c in zip(group_cols, key):
            rec[c] = c
        for mname, series in [("net_pickup_value_proxy", g["net_pickup_value_proxy"]),

            rec[f"{mname}_p25"] = series.quantile(0.25) if len(series) else np.nan
            rec[f"{mname}_p75"] = series.quantile(0.75) if len(series) else np.nan
        rec["faixa_amostral"] = "critico_<5" if n < 5 else ("pequeno_5-19" if n < 20 else ("medio_20-49" if n < 50 else "grande_50+"))
        out.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

save(agg_pick(pickw, ["suburb"]), "pickup_by_suburb.csv")
save(agg_pick(pickw, ["suburb", "bedr", "typ"]), "pickup_by_segment.csv")

# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO 5 ÔÇö segmento por horizonte (long)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("OBJETIVO 5 ÔÇö segmentos por horizonte (H=30,60,91) ÔÇö tabela longa")

    n_total = len(g)

    rec = {"horizon": int(H), "suburb": subb, "number_of_bedrooms": bd,

# ranking reconciliation H=91 for 4 bairros (ponto 2): order by static revenue proxy median
filt91 = segments[(segments["horizon"] == 91)]

mar = master.copy()

def thesis_row(mask, label):

    n_any = int(sub["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(any_caps).sum())
    n_snap = int(sub["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(caps[MAIN_DAY]).sum())
    n_proc = int((sub["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0).sum())

    srp = gc["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].median() if len(gc) else np.nan
    cls = "evid├¬ncia_insuficiente" if (n_det < 5 or n_any < 5 or n_proc < 5) else "amostra_suficiente"
    return {"perfil": label, "N_details": n_det, "N_any_price_av": n_any,
            "N_snapshot_20jan": n_snap, "N_com_proxy_H": n_proc,
            "ADR_median_91": adr, "static_rev_proxy_median_91": srp,

    thesis_row(BR0 & CENTRO, "studio+Centro"),

    rt = pd.DataFrame(tmp).T.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "airbnb_listing_id"})

print("  top6 bairro por ADR em cada snapshot (N registrado):")

    g = robust[(robust["dim"] == "suburb") & (robust["snapshot"] == d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))].sort_values("ADR_median", ascending=False).head(6)
