"""
M├®tricas de performance Airbnb ÔÇö PROXY. Snapshot principal 20/01/2025.

Decis├úo metodol├│gica (Price_AV = calend├írio de PRE├çOS DISPON├ìVEIS):
  - linha existente                   => data dispon├¡vel com pre├ºo anunciado;
  - aus├¬ncia de stay em D..D+90       => INDISPON├ìVEL (PROXY);
  - indispon├¡vel N├âO = reserva (bloqueio/manuten├º├úo/uso do propriet├írio);
  - listing ausente do Price_AV       => estado desconhecido (n├úo 100% indispon├¡vel).

Revis├úo final:
  static_revenue_proxy_H = median_available_price_H ├ù unavailable_nights_H
    (pressup├Áe que a mediana das noites ainda dispon├¡veis aproxima o valor das
     indispon├¡veis). NUNCA ├® receita observada.
  pickup = segunda evid├¬ncia independente e temporal; nunca chame de reservas.

FAZ: proxies por listing/horizonte, pickup normalizado, painel, segmentos,
     tese, robustez entre snapshots.
N├âO faz: VivaReal, ROI, anualiza├º├úo, ML, escolha de im├│vel, altera├º├úo de data/.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

PD = pd.Timestamp
MAIN_DAY = PD("2025-01-20")
D06 = PD("2025-01-06")
D07 = PD("2025-01-07")
DAYS = [D06, D07, MAIN_DAY]
HORIZONS = [30, 60, 91]
COMMON_DATES = pd.date_range(MAIN_DAY, D06 + pd.Timedelta(days=90), freq="D")


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")


def norma(val):
    return "Missing/Unknown" if (val is None or (isinstance(val, float) and pd.isna(val))) else val


def faixa(n):
    if n < 5:
        return "critico_<5"
    if n < 20:
        return "pequeno_5-19"
    if n < 50:
        return "medio_20-49"
    return "grande_50+"


# ---------------- carga ----------------
details = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Details_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str, "owner_id": str})
mesh = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
price = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Price_AV_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
price["aquisition_date"] = pd.to_datetime(price["aquisition_date"], errors="coerce")
price["capture_day"] = price["aquisition_date"].dt.floor("D")
price["stay"] = pd.to_datetime(price["date"], errors="coerce").dt.normalize()
price["lead"] = (price["stay"] - price["capture_day"]).dt.days
price["price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(price["price"], errors="coerce")

print("=" * 78)
print("REPRO ÔÇö PROPRIEDADES Price_AV")
assert price["capture_day"].dropna().nunique() == 3, "captures != 3"
for d in DAYS:
    s = price[price["capture_day"] == d]
    assert s["lead"].between(0, 90).all(), f"lead fora de [0,90] em {d:%Y-%m-%d}"
    assert not s.duplicated(subset=["airbnb_listing_id", "stay"]).any(), f"dup em {d:%Y-%m-%d}"
caps = {d: set(price.loc[price["capture_day"] == d, "airbnb_listing_id"].unique()) for d in DAYS}
print("  listings por capture:", {d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"): len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS})
print("  interse├º├úo 06├ù20:", len(caps[D06] & caps[MAIN_DAY]),
      "| interse├º├úo 3:", len(caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]))
snapshot = caps[MAIN_DAY]

# ============================================================
# 1. m├®tricas por listing/horizonte (20/01)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 1 ÔÇö m├®tricas por listing (H=30,60,91)")
main = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY].copy()
rows = []
for lid, sub in main.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
    for H in HORIZONS:
        s = sub[(sub["lead"] >= 0) & (sub["lead"] < H)]
        avail = len(s)
        unavail = H - avail
        rate = unavail / H
        pr = s["price_num"].dropna()
        n_price = int(len(pr))
        med = float(pr.median()) if n_price else np.nan
        mean = float(pr.mean()) if n_price else np.nan
        p25 = float(pr.quantile(0.25)) if n_price else np.nan
        p75 = float(pr.quantile(0.75)) if n_price else np.nan
        rows.append({
            "airbnb_listing_id": lid, "horizon": H,
            "available_nights_H": avail, "unavailable_nights_H": unavail,
            "unavailability_rate_H": rate,
            "median_available_price_H": med, "mean_available_price_H": mean,
            "p25_price_H": p25, "p75_price_H": p75,
            "n_prices_observed_H": n_price,
            "static_rev_px_per_night_H": (med * rate if n_price else np.nan),
            "static_revenue_proxy_H": (med * unavail if n_price else np.nan),
        })
metrics = pd.DataFrame(rows)
metrics["is_in_price_av_20jan"] = metrics["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(snapshot).astype(int)
metrics["has_price_in_horizon"] = (metrics["n_prices_observed_H"] > 0).astype(int)
metrics["flag_no_price_in_horizon"] = (
    (metrics["is_in_price_av_20jan"] == 1) & (metrics["has_price_in_horizon"] == 0)).astype(int)

W = metrics.pivot_table(index="airbnb_listing_id", columns="horizon",
                        values=["available_nights_H", "unavailable_nights_H",
                                "unavailability_rate_H", "median_available_price_H",
                                "mean_available_price_H", "p25_price_H", "p75_price_H",
                                "n_prices_observed_H", "static_revenue_proxy_H"],
                        aggfunc="first")
W.columns = [f"{v}_{int(k)}" for v, k in W.columns]
W = W.reset_index()
for H in HORIZONS:
    W[f"has_price_H_{H}"] = W[f"n_prices_observed_H_{H}"].fillna(0) > 0

print("  --- cobertura por horizonte (20/01) ---")
snapshot_in_details = snapshot & set(details["airbnb_listing_id"])
for H in HORIZONS:
    seg = metrics[metrics["horizon"] == H]
    n_with = int((seg["n_prices_observed_H"] > 0).sum())
    n_without = int((seg["n_prices_observed_H"] == 0).sum())
    print(f"   H={H}: snapshot={len(snapshot)} Detalhes-conect├íveis={len(snapshot_in_details)} "
          f"| com pre├ºo={n_with} sem pre├ºo={n_without}")
print("  NOTA: listing pode estar no snapshot mas ter 0 datas dispon├¡veis em H "
      "=> sem pre├ºo => static proxy NaN, SEM imputa├º├úo, flag levantada.")

# ============================================================
# 4. master (Details + Mesh 1:1 + m├®tricas wide)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 4 ÔÇö master (Details+Mesh, 1:1)")
numc = ["number_of_bedrooms", "number_of_bathrooms", "number_of_guests",
        "number_of_beds", "number_of_reviews", "cleaning_fee", "star_rating"]
det_cols = ["airbnb_listing_id", "listing_type"] + numc
master_df = details[[c for c in det_cols if c in details.columns]].copy()
master_df = master_df.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="inner")
assert master_df["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "master n├úo 1:1"
for c in numc:
    master_df[c] = pd.to_numeric(master_df[c], errors="coerce")
master_df["star_rating_original"] = master_df["star_rating"]
master_df["star_rating_clean"] = np.where(
    (master_df["star_rating"].fillna(-1) == 0) & (master_df["number_of_reviews"].fillna(-1) == 0),
    np.nan, master_df["star_rating"])
master_df = master_df.merge(W, on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
master_df["is_in_price_av_20jan"] = master_df["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(snapshot).astype(int)
master_df["is_balanced_panel"] = master_df["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(
    caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]).astype(int)
save(master_df, "listing_metrics.csv")

# ============================================================
# 3. painel balanceado
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 3 ÔÇö painel balanceado")
inter3 = caps[D06] & caps[D07] & caps[MAIN_DAY]
bal_sum = pd.DataFrame({"dia": [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in DAYS],
                        "n_listings": [len(caps[d]) for d in DAYS]})
bal_sum.loc[len(bal_sum)] = ["intersecao_3_snapshots", len(inter3)]
save(bal_sum, "balanced_panel_summary.csv")
save(pd.DataFrame({"airbnb_listing_id": sorted(inter3)}), "balanced_panel.csv")

# ============================================================
# 2. booking-pickup proxy (06/01 -> 20/01)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 2 ÔÇö booking-pickup proxy (06/01 ÔåÆ 20/01)")
a06 = price[price["capture_day"] == D06]
a20 = price[price["capture_day"] == MAIN_DAY]
universe = caps[D06] & caps[MAIN_DAY]  # presen├ºa nos 2, sem exigir linha na janela
print(f"  universo = 06Ôê®20 = {len(universe)} (janela {COMMON_DATES.min().date()} a {COMMON_DATES.max().date()}, {len(COMMON_DATES)} datas)")


def avail_map(df, lid):
    sub = df[(df["airbnb_listing_id"] == lid) & (df["stay"].isin(COMMON_DATES))]
    return set(sub["stay"]), sub.set_index("stay")["price_num"]


nwin = len(COMMON_DATES)
pick = []
for lid in universe:
    s06, p06 = avail_map(a06, lid)
    s20, p20 = avail_map(a20, lid)
    a2u = len(s06 - s20)
    u2a = len(s20 - s06)
    net = a2u - u2a
    pv = float(p06.loc[list(s06 - s20)].sum()) if (s06 - s20) else 0.0
    rv = float(p20.loc[list(s20 - s06)].sum()) if (s20 - s06) else 0.0
    pick.append({"airbnb_listing_id": lid,
                 "available_to_unavailable_nights": a2u,
                 "unavailable_to_available_nights": u2a,
                 "net_unavailability_pickup": net,
                 "available_to_unavailable_rate": a2u / nwin,
                 "unavailable_to_available_rate": u2a / nwin,
                 "net_transition_rate": net / nwin,
                 "pickup_value_proxy": pv, "release_value_proxy": rv,
                 "net_pickup_value_proxy": pv - rv, "n_common_dates": nwin})
pick_df = pd.DataFrame(pick)
save(pick_df, "pickup_metrics.csv")

pickw = pick_df.merge(master_df[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
                      on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
pickw["suburb"] = pickw["suburb"].apply(norma)
pickw["bedr"] = pickw["number_of_bedrooms"].apply(norma)
pickw["typ"] = pickw["listing_type"].apply(norma)


def agg_pick(df, group_cols):
    out = []
    for keys, g in df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False):
        key = keys if isinstance(keys, tuple) else (keys,)
        rec = {"N_listings": len(g)}
        for k, c in zip(group_cols, key):
            rec[k] = c
        for mname, series in [("net_pickup_value_proxy", g["net_pickup_value_proxy"]),
                              ("net_transition_rate", g["net_transition_rate"]),
                              ("net_pickup_nights", g["net_unavailability_pickup"])]:
            series = series.dropna()
            rec[f"{mname}_sum"] = series.sum() if len(series) else np.nan
            rec[f"{mname}_mean"] = series.mean() if len(series) else np.nan
            rec[f"{mname}_median"] = series.median() if len(series) else np.nan
            rec[f"{mname}_p25"] = series.quantile(0.25) if len(series) else np.nan
            rec[f"{mname}_p75"] = series.quantile(0.75) if len(series) else np.nan
        rec["faixa_amostral"] = banda(len(g))
        out.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(out)


save(agg_pick(pickw, ["suburb"]), "pickup_by_suburb.csv")
save(agg_pick(pickw, ["suburb", "bedr", "typ"]), "pickup_by_segment.csv")

# ============================================================
# 5. segmento por horizonte (tabela longa H=30,60,91)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 5 ÔÇö segmentos por horizonte (long)")
mseg = metrics.merge(master[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
                     on="airbnb_listing_id", how="inner")
mseg["suburb"] = mseg["suburb"].apply(norma)
mseg["bedr"] = mseg["number_of_bedrooms"].fillna(-1)
mseg["typ"] = mseg["listing_type"].apply(norma)
seg_rows = []
for (H, sub, bd, tp), g in mseg.groupby(["horizon", "suburb", "bedr", "typ"], dropna=False):
    n_total = len(g)
    gc = g[g["flag_no_price_in_horizon"] == 0]
    rec = {"horizon": int(H), "suburb": sub, "number_of_bedrooms": bd,
           "listing_type": tp, "N_total": n_total, "N_com_proxy": len(gc)}
    for label, col in [("ADR", "median_available_price_H"),
                       ("unavailability", "unavailability_rate_H"),
                       ("static_rev", "static_revenue_proxy_H")]:
        s = gc[col].dropna()
        rec[f"{label}_median"] = s.median() if len(s) else np.nan
        rec[f"{label}_mean"] = s.mean() if len(s) else np.nan
        rec[f"{label}_p25"] = s.quantile(0.25) if len(s) else np.nan
        rec[f"{label}_p75"] = s.quantile(0.75) if len(s) else np.nan
    rec["faixa_amostral"] = banda3(n_total)
    seg_rows.append(rec)
segments = pd.DataFrame(seg_rows)
save(segments, "segment_by_horizon.csv")

filt91 = segments[(segments["horizon"] == 91)]
four = filt91[filt91["suburb"].isin(["Meia Praia", "Centro", "Morretes", "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras"])].sort_values("static_rev_median", ascending=False)
print("  Ranking H=91 (por static_rev_median):")
print(four[["suburb", "N_total", "N_com_proxy", "ADR_median", "unavailability_median", "static_rev_median"]].to_string(index=False))

# ============================================================
# 6. tese dos compactos
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 6 ÔÇö tese dos compactos")
mar = master_df.copy()
mar["suburb_low"] = mar["suburb"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
mar["tipo_low"] = mar["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
BR0 = pd.to_numeric(mar["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce").astype(float) == 0
BR1 = pd.to_numeric(mar["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce").astype(float) == 1
CENTRO = mar["suburb_low"] == "centro"
APTO = mar["tipo_low"] == "apartamento"
any_caps = caps[D06] | caps[D07] | caps[MAIN_DAY]


def thesis_row(mask, label):
    sub = mar[mask]
    n_det = len(sub)
    n_any = int(sub["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(any_caps).sum())
    n_snap = int(sub["airbnb_listing_id"].isin(snapshot).sum())
    n_proc = int((sub["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0).sum())
    gc = sub[sub["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0]
    adr = gc["median_available_price_H_91"].median() if len(gc) else np.nan
    srp = gc["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].median() if len(gc) else np.nan
    cls = "evid├¬ncia_insuficiente" if (n_det < 5 or n_any < 5 or n_proc < 5) else "amostra_suficiente"
    return {"perfil": label, "N_details": n_det, "N_any_price_av": n_any,
            "N_snapshot_20jan": n_snap, "N_com_proxy_H": n_proc,
            "ADR_median_91": adr, "static_rev_proxy_median_91": srp,
            "classificacao": cls}


thesis = pd.DataFrame([
    thesis_row(BR0 & CENTRO, "studio+Centro"),
    thesis_row(BR1 & CENTRO, "1quart+Centro"),
    thesis_row(APTO & BR1 & CENTRO, "apart+1quart+Centro"),
])
save(thesis, "compact_thesis.csv")
print(thesis.to_string(index=False))

# ============================================================
# 7. robustez entre snapshots (H=91 de cada um)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78); print("OBJETIVO 7 ÔÇö robustez entre snapshots")
rob_rows = []
for d in DAYS:
    sub_p = price[price["capture_day"] == d]
    tmp = {}
    for lid, sg in sub_p.groupby("airbnb_listing_id"):
        s = sg[(sg["lead"] >= 0) & (sg["lead"] < 91)]
        pr = s["price_num"].dropna()
        tmp[lid] = {"ADR": pr.median() if len(pr) else np.nan,
                    "unav": (91 - len(s)) / 91 if len(s) else np.nan,
                    "rev": (pr.median() * (91 - len(s))) if len(pr) else np.nan}
    rt = pd.DataFrame(tmp).T.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "airbnb_listing_id"})
    rt = rt.merge(master_df[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb", "number_of_bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
                  on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")
    rt["suburb_low"] = rt["suburb"].apply(norma).astype(str).str.lower()
    rt["bedr"] = rt["number_of_bedrooms"].fillna(-1)
    for group_cols, dim in [(["suburb_low"], "suburb_low"), (["bedr"], "bedrooms"),
                            (["suburb_low", "bedr", "listing_type"], "full")]:
        gg = rt.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False).agg(N=("airbnb_listing_id", "count"),
                                                      ADR=("ADR", "median"),
                                                      unav=("unav", "median"),
                                                      rev=("rev", "median")).reset_index()
        gg["dim"] = dim
        gg["snapshot"] = d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        rob_rows.append(gg)
robust = pd.concat(rob_rows, ignore_index=True)
robust["faixa_amostral"] = robust["N"].apply(banda)
save(robust, "snapshot_robustness.csv")

print("  top6 bairro por ADR (N registrado):")
for d in DAYS:
    g = robust[(robust["dim"] == "suburb_low") & (robust["snapshot"] == d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))].sort_values("ADR", ascending=False).head(6)
    print(f"  {d:%m-%d}:")
    for _, r in g.iterrows():
        print(f"     {r['suburb_low']:>24} ADR={r['ADR']:.0f} unav={r['unav']:.3f} rev={r['rev']:.0f} [N={int(r['N'])}]")

print("\nDONE")

    agg.columns = ["ADR_median", "ADR_mean"]

- Isso significa que the **proxy est├ítica (pre├ºo├ùindisponibilidade) classifica Meia Praia acima, mas a din├ómica temporal sugere que o Centro tem maior press├úo de demanda por im├│vel**. ├ë uma contradi├º├úo est├ítica vs. din├ómica relevante para a tese ÔÇö deixo expl├¡cita.

## E. N├║meros corretos da tese 1Q Centro

| perfil | N_details | N_any_price_av | N_20jan | N_com_proxy | ADR_91 | static_rev_91 | classifica├º├úo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| studio+Centro | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | NaN | NaN | evid├¬ncia_insuficiente |
| 1quart+Centro | **165** | **82** | **79** | **79** | **431,4** | **10.416** | amostra_suficiente |
| apart+1quart+Centro | **116** | **78** | **75** | **75** | **450** | **10.416** | amostra_suficiente |

Studio+Centro tem amostra m├¡nima (3 im├│veis), e o 1Q-Centro est├í bem amostrado (N=79), com static_rev 10.416 ÔÇö bem abaixo de Meia Praia (31.920) e at├® de Morretes.

## F. Contradi├º├Áes restantes
- **Centro`intensidade de pickup superior` vs proxy est├ítica inferior** a Meia Praia: a din├ómica temporal favorece Centro mais que o snapshot est├ítico mostra (explicitado acima, ├® informa├º├úo, n├úo a escondo).
- **ranking H invertendo** entre 30/60 e 91 para Morretes vs Centro ÔÇö estabilidade apenas parcial; reporto ambos sem resolv├¬-la for├ºadamente.

## G. Est├í pronto como entrada do VivaReal?
**Sim para a parte refere ao custo.** Ponto de aten├º├úo: `listing_metrics.csv` e as agregadas por bairro/quartos usando **apenas listings no snapshot 20/01** (cobertura ~22% do total de Details). O VivaReal traz a oferta de compra; para combinar sem vi├®s de amostra do Air-db, o pr├│prio VivaReal deve filtrar para os mesmos perfis/bairros e, de prefer├¬ncia, os listings que existem nos dois circuitos (via bairro+quartos+tipo, decidido na etapa 03). Os `faixa_amostral` j├í sinalizam segmentos pequenos. Pronto para a integra├º├úo de custo/retono na `src/03`.

Rodei `01` e `02` novamente, sem apagar nada ÔÇö todos os `audit_*` e artefatos coexistem em `outputs/tables/`.

Por favor: **snapshot `listing_metrics.csv` est├í em boa forma mas `listing_metrics_wide.csv` n├úo ├® mais produzido** (o master agora ├® `listing_metrics.csv`). Quer que eu remova `listing_metrics_wide.csv` antigo, ou conserva para coexist├¬ncia? (Por padr├úo mantive.) A pr├│xima etapa pode ser a integra├º├úo do VivaReal para retorno/unidade.

--- src/03_investment_analysis.py

@@ -0,0 +1,363 @@
+"""
+An├ílise de investimento Airbnb x VivaReal (Itapema).
+
+M├®trica principal Airbnb: static_revenue_proxy_91 (H30/H60 = sensibilidades).
+Pickup temporal = 2a evidencia independente.
+Regras:
+  - N├âO anualiza m├®trica;
+  - N├âO trata capital_efficiency como ROI real / yield anual (├® proxy bruto p/ janela);
+  - N├âO usa ML; N├âO escolhe vencedor antes; N├âO cria score ponderado arbitr├írio.
+  - Liga├º├úo Airbnb<->VivaReal ├® CONCEITUAL (bairro x bedrooms x tipo); n├úo h├í match real.
+
+Artefatos: outputs/tables/.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
+    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
+    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")
+
+
+def faixa(n):
+    if n < 5:
+        return "critico_<5"
+    if n < 20:
+        return "pequeno_5-19"
+    if n < 50:
+        return "medio_20-49"
+    return "grande_50+"
+
+
+def norm_bairro(s):
+    """Mapping expl├¡cito (sem fuzzy matching). Retorna None se n├úo defens├ível."""
+    if s is None or (isinstance(s, float) and (pd.isna(s) or s == "")):
+        return None
+    s = str(s).strip()
+    if not s:
+        return None
+    k = s.lower()
+    mp = {
+        "centro": "Centro",
+        "meia praia": "Meia Praia",
+        "meia praia - frente mar": "Meia Praia",
+        "meia praia - frente-mar": "Meia Praia",
+        "morretes": "Morretes",
+        "tabuleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
+        "taboleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
+        "tabuleiro dos oliveiras": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
+        "sertao do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
+        "sertaozinho": "Sertaozinho",
+        "sertao do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
+        "altas sao bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
+        "alto sao bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
+        "casa branca": "Casa Branca",
+        "canto da praia": "Canto da Praia",
+        "ilhota": "Ilhota",
+        "varzea": "Varzea",
+        "jardim praia mar": "Jardim Praiamar",
+        "andorinha": "Andorinha",
+        "estreito": "Estreito",
+        "ocean tower": "Ocean Tower",
+    }
+    return mp.get(k, s.title())
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 1. LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA DO VivaReal
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("1. LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA VivaReal")
+vr = pd.read_csv(DATA / "VivaReal_Itapema.csv", dtype={"listing_id": str})
+print("  linhas:", len(vr), "| ids unicos:", vr["listing_id"].nunique(),
+      "| ocorrencias repetidas:", int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()))
+
+dup = vr[vr["listing_id"].duplicated(keep=False)]
+groups = dup.groupby("listing_id")
+all_cols = vr.columns.tolist()
+fields = ["sale_price", "usable_area", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "parking_spaces",
+          "suburb", "listing_type", "business_types", "monthly_condo_fee", "yearly_iptu"]
+exact = amen_only = other = 0
+for gid, g in groups:
+    base = g.iloc[0].fillna("__NA__")
+    difset = set()
+    for _, row in g.iloc[1:].fillna("__NA__").iterrows():
+        for c in all_cols:
+            if row[c] != base[c]:
+                difset.add(c)
+    if not difset:
+        exact += 1
+    elif difset <= {"amenities"}:
+        amen_only += 1
+    else:
+        other += 1
+key_consistent = 0
+for gid, g in groups:
+    if g[fields].fillna("__NA__").nunique().eq(1).all():
+        key_consistent += 1
+print(f"  grupos dup: {groups.ngroups} | {exact} c├│pias exatas, "
+      f"{amen_only} diferem s├│ em emitters, {other} outras diverg├¬ncias")
+print(f"  grupos com campos-chave 100% consistentes: {key_consistent}/{groups.ngroups}")
+
+dups_audit = pd.DataFrame([{
+    "linhas": len(vr),
+    "listing_id_unicos": vr["listing_id"].nunique(),
+    "ocorrencias_repetidas": int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()),
+    "grupos": groups.ngroups,
+    "copias_exatas": exact,
+    "diferem_so_amenities": amen_only,
+    "diferem_outras_colunas": other,
+    "campos_chave_consistentes": key_consistent,
+}])
+save(dups_audit, "vivareal_duplicates_audit.csv")
+
+vr = vr.drop_duplicates("listing_id", keep="first").copy()
+print("  apos dedup linhas:", len(vr))
+
+# ============================================================
+# 2. UNIVERSO RESIDENCIAL COMPAR├üVEL
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("2. UNIVERSO RESIDENCIAL")
+print("  listing_type:", vr["listing_type"].value_counts().to_dict())
+vr["is_residential_comparable"] = vr["listing_type"].isin(["apartamento", "casa"])
+print("  residencial (apartamen+casa):", int(vr["is_residential_comparable"].sum()))
+print("  business_types:", vr["business_types"].value_counts().to_dict())
+ambos = vr[vr["business_types"] == "Ambos"]
+print("  Ambos: N =", len(ambos), "| com sale_price:", int(ambos["sale_price"].notna().sum()))
+
+# ============================================================
+# 3. NORMALIZA├ç├âO EXPL├ìCITA DE BAIRROS
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("3. NORMALIZA├ç├âO DE BAIRROS")
+vr["suburb_original"] = vr["suburb"]
+vr["suburb_canonical"] = vr["suburb"].apply(norm_bairro)
+vr["flag_frente_mar"] = vr["suburb"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("frente mar").astype(int)
+vr["suburb_mapping_applied"] = vr["suburb_canonical"].notna().astype(int)
+submap = (vr[["suburb_original", "suburb_canonical"]].value_counts()
+          .rename("n").reset_index().sort_values("n", ascending=False))
+save(submap, "vivareal_suburb_mapping.csv")
+print("  mapeados:", int(vr["suburb_mapping_applied"].sum()),
+      "| NA (sem direto):", int((vr["suburb_canonical"].isna()).sum()))
+print(submap.to_string(index=False))
+
+# ============================================================
+# 4. OUTLIERS ÔÇö n├úo remover silenciosamente
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("4. OUTLIERS")
+vr["sale_price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["sale_price"], errors="coerce")
+vr["usable_area_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["usable_area"], errors="coerce")
+vr["price_per_m2"] = np.where(vr["usable_area_num"] > 0,
+                              vr["sale_price_num"] / vr["usable_area_num"], np.nan)
+print("  sale_price missing:", int(vr["sale_price_num"].isna().sum()),
+      "| usable_area missing:", int(vr["usable_area_num"].isna().sum()),
+      "| area<=0 (sem pre├ºo/m2):", int((vr["usable_area_num"] <= 0).sum()))
+q = vr["sale_price_num"].describe()
+print("  sale_price describe:\n", q.round(0))
+iqr = q["75%"] - q["25%"]
+vr["flag_outlier_price"] = (vr["sale_price_num"] > q["75%"] + 3 * iqr).astype(int)
+pm2 = vr["price_per_m2"].quantile(0.99)
+vr["flag_outlier_m2"] = (vr["price_per_m2"] > pm2).astype(int)
+print("  flag_price_outlier:", int(vr["flag_outlier_price"].sum()),
+      "| flag_m2_outlier:", int(vr["flag_outlier_m2"].sum()))
+ol = vr[["listing_id", "suburb_original", "suburb_canonical", "sale_price_num",
+         "usable_area_num", "price_per_m2", "listing_type", "bedrooms",
+         "flag_outlier_price", "flag_outlier_m2"]].sort_values("sale_price_num", ascending=False)
+save(ol, "vivareal_outlier_review.csv")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 5. SEGMENTOS DE COMPRA (VivaReal)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("5. SEGMENTOS DE COMPRA")
+
+
+def seg_purchase(df):
+    out = []
+    for (subb, b, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
+        n = len(g)
+        sp = g["sale_price_num"].dropna()
+        rec = {"suburb_canonical": subb, "bedrooms": b, "listing_type": tp, "N_sale": n}
+        rec["median_sale_price"] = sp.median() if len(sp) else np.nan
+        rec["mean_sale_price"] = sp.mean() if len(sp) else np.nan
+        rec["p25_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.25) if len(sp) else np.nan
+        rec["p75_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.75) if len(sp) else np.nan
+        rec["median_usable_area"] = g["usable_area_num"].median()
+        rec["median_price_per_m2"] = g["price_per_m2"].median()
+        cf = pd.to_numeric(g["monthly_condo_fee"], errors="coerce")
+        rec["median_monthly_condo_fee"] = cf.median()
+        rec["missing_rate_condo"] = cf.isna().mean()
+        ip = pd.to_numeric(g["yearly_iptu"], errors="coerce")
+        rec["median_yearly_iptu"] = ip.median()
+        rec["missing_rate_iptu"] = ip.isna().mean()
+        rec["faixa_vivareal"] = faixa(n)
+        out.append(rec)
+    return pd.DataFrame(out)
+
+
+purch = seg_purchase(vr)
+save(purch, "purchase_segments.csv")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 6. INTEGRAR COM AIRBNB (conceitu┬¡al)
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("6. INTEGRAR COM AIRB")
+metrics = pd.read_csv(OUT / "listing_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
+metrics["suburb_canonical"] = metrics["suburb"].apply(norm_bairro)
+metrics["bedrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(metrics["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce")
+metrics["listing_type"] = metrics["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
+bo_bit = metrics[metrics["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0].copy()
+
+pick = pd.read_csv(OUT / "pickup_metrics.csv", encoding="utf-8", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})

+def airbnb_stats(df):
+    out = {}

+        g = g[g["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0]

+            "static_rev_91_p75": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].quantile(0.75) if n else np.nan,
+            "static_rev_30_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_30"].median() if n else np.nan,
+            "static_rev_60_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_60"].median() if n else np.nan,
+            "ADR_30_median": g["median_available_price_H_30"].median() if n else np.nan,

+# ============================================================

"""
An├ílise de investimento Airbnb ├ù VivaReal (Itapema).

M├®trica principal Airbnb: static_revenue_proxy_91 (H30/H60 = sensibilidades;
pickup temporal = 2┬¬ evid├¬ncia independente).

Regras:
  - N├âO anualiza m├®trica;
  - capital_efficiency_proxy N├âO ├® ROI/yield real (├® proxy bruto para a janela);
  - N├âO usa ML; N├âO escolhe vencedor antecipadamente; N├âO cria score ponderado.
  - Liga├º├úo AirbnbÔåöVivaReal ├® CONCEITUAL (bairro ├ù bedrooms ├ù listing_type),
    n├úo h├í match im├│vel-a-im├│vel.

Sa├¡das em outputs/tables/.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print(f"  saved -> outputs/tables/{name} (rows={len(df)})")


def faixa(n):
    if n < 5:
        return "critico_<5"
    if n < 20:
        return "pequeno_5-19"
    if n < 50:
        return "medio_20-49"
    return "grande_50+"


def norm_bairro(s):
    """Mapping expl├¡cito e audit├ível (sem fuzzy matching)."""
    s = str(s).strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    k = s.lower()
    mp = {
        "centro": "Centro",
        "meia praia": "Meia Praia",
        "meia praia - frente mar": "Meia Praia",
        "morretes": "Morretes",
        "tabuleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "taboleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "tabuleiro dos oliveiras": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "sertao do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
        "sert├úo do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
        "sertaozinho": "Sertaozinho",
        "sert├úozinho": "Sertaozinho",
        "alto s├úo bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
        "alto sao bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
        "casa branca": "Casa Branca",
        "canto da praia": "Canto da Praia",
        "ilhota": "Ilhota",
        "varzea": "Varzea",
        "jardim praia mar": "Jardim Praiamar",
        "ocean tower": "Ocean Tower",
        "andorinha": "Andorinha",
        "estreito": "Estreito",
    }
    if k in mp:
        return mp[k]
    return s.title()  # fallback capitalizado, sem for├ºar categoria


# ============================================================
# 1. LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA DO VivaReal
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("1. VIVAREAL ÔÇö LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA")
vr = pd.read_csv(DATA / "VivaReal_Itapema.csv", dtype={"listing_id": str})
n_rows = len(vr)
n_unique = vr["listing_id"].nunique()
print(f"  linhas={n_rows} | listing_id ├║nicos={n_unique} | ocorr. extras={int(vr['listing_id'].duplicated().sum())}")

dup = vr[vr["listing_id"].duplicated(keep=False)]
groups = dup.groupby("listing_id")
fields = ["sale_price", "usable_area", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "parking_spaces",
          "suburb", "listing_type", "business_types", "monthly_condo_fee", "yearly_iptu"]
all_cols = vr.columns.tolist()
exact = amen_only = other = 0
for gid, g in groups:
    base = g.iloc[0].fillna("__NA__")
    difset = set()
    for _, row in g.iloc[1:].fillna("__NA__").iterrows():
        for c in all_cols:
            if row[c] != base[c]:
                difset.add(c)
    if not difset:
        exact += 1
    elif difset <= {"amenities"}:
        amen_only += 1
    else:
        other += 1
print(f"  {groups.ngroups} grupos repetidos: {exact} c├│pias exatas, "
      f"{amen_only} diferem s├│ em amenities, {other} outras vieses")
# consist├¬ncia campos-chave dentro de cada grupo
key_consistent = 0
for gid, g in groups:
    if g[fields].fillna("__NA__").nunique(dropna=False).eq(1).all():
        key_consistent += 1
print(f"  grupos com campos-chave 100% consistentes: {key_consistent}/{groups.ngroups}")

dup_audit = pd.DataFrame([{
    "grupos_duplicados": groups.ngroups,
    "linhas_dup_keep_false": int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated(keep=False).sum()),
    "linhas_redundantes_keep_first": int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()),
    "exatas_todas_colunas": exact, "diferem_so_amenities": amen_only,
    "diferem_outras_colunas": other,
    "campos_chave_consistentes": key_consistent,
}])
save(dup_audit, "vivareal_duplicates_audit.csv")

# deduplicar mantendo primeira linha
vr = vr.drop_duplicates("listing_id", keep="first").copy()
print("  ap├│s dedup linhas:", len(vr))

# ============================================================
# 2. UNIVERSO RESIDENCIAL COMPAR├üVEL
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("2. UNIVERSO RESIDENCIAL")
print("  listing_type:", vr["listing_type"].value_counts().to_dict())
vr["is_residential_comparable"] = vr["listing_type"].isin(["apartamento", "casa"])
print("  residencial compar├ível (apart+ casa):", int(vr["is_residential_comparable"].sum()))
print("  business_types:", vr["business_types"].value_counts().to_dict())
ambos = vr[vr["business_types"] == "Ambos"]
print("  Ambos: N=", len(ambos),
      "| com sale_price:", int(ambos["sale_price"].notna().sum()))

# ============================================================
# 3. NORMALIZA├ç├âO EXPL├ìCITA DE BAIRROS
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("3. NORMALIZA├ç├âO DE BAIRROS")
vr["suburb_original"] = vr["suburb"]
vr["suburb_canonical"] = vr["suburb"].apply(norm_bairro)
# flag frente-mar (preserva informa├º├úo sem for├ºar agrupamento)
vr["flag_frente_mar"] = vr["suburb"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains("frente mar").astype(int)
# para valores que n├úo se defendem, manter como est├úo (n├úo force)
vr["suburb_mapping_applied"] = ~vr["suburb"].isna() & (vr["suburb_canonical"].notna())

submap = (vr.groupby(["suburb_original", "suburb_canonical"]).size()
          .reset_index(name="frequencia").sort_values("frequencia", ascending=False))
save(submap, "vivareal_suburb_mapping.csv")
print("  mapeamento aplicado em", int(vr["suburb_mapping_applied"].sum()),
      "| non-canonical restantes:", vr["suburb_canonical"].isna().sum())
print(submap.to_string(index=False))

# ============================================================
# 4. OUTLIERS ÔÇö n├úo remover silenciosamente
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("4. OUTLIERS / price_per_m2")
vr["sale_price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["sale_price"], errors="coerce")
vr["usable_area_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["usable_area"], errors="coerce")
area_pos = vr["usable_area_num"] > 0
vr["price_per_m2"] = np.where(area_pos, vr["sale_price_num"] / vr["usable_area_num"], np.nan)
vr["sale_price_na"] = vr["sale_price_num"].isna()
vr["area_na"] = vr["usable_area_num"].isna()
print("  sale_price missing:", int(vr["sale_price_na"].sum()),
      "| usable_area missing:", int(vr["area_na"].sum()),
      "| area <=0 (sem price/m2):", int((~area_pos).sum()))
q = vr["sale_price_num"].describe()
print("  sale_price describe:\n", q.round(0))
# flags de suspeito (n├úo remove)
vr["flag_outlier_price"] = (vr["sale_price_num"] >= q["75%"] + 3 * (q["75%"] - q["25%"])).astype(int)
vr["flag_outlier_m2"] = vr["price_per_m2"] >= vr["price_per_m2"].quantile(0.995)
print("  price flag outliers:", int(vr["flag_outlier_price"].sum()))

ol_cols = ["listing_id", "suburb_original", "suburb_canonical", "sale_price_num",
           "usable_area_num", "price_per_m2", "listing_type", "bedrooms",
           "flag_outlier_price", "flag_outlier_m2"]
save(vr[ol_cols].sort_values("sale_price_num", ascending=False), "vivareal_outlier_review.csv")

# ============================================================
# 5. SEGMENTOS DE COMPRA (VivaReal)
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("5. SEGMENTOS DE COMPRA (VivaReal)")

def seg_purchase(df):
    out = []
    for (subb, bd, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
        n = len(g)
        sp = g["sale_price_num"].dropna()
        rec = {"suburb_canonical": subb, "bedrooms": bd, "listing_type": tp, "N_sale": n}
        rec["median_sale_price"] = sp.median() if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["mean_sale_price"] = sp.mean() if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["p25_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.25) if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["p75_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.75) if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["median_usable_area"] = g["usable_area_num"].median()
        p2 = g["price_per_m2"].dropna()
        rec["median_price_per_m2"] = p2.median() if len(p2) else np.nan
        cf = g["monthly_condo_fee"]
        rec["median_monthly_condo_fee"] = pd.to_numeric(cf, errors="coerce").median()
        rec["missing_rate_condo"] = cf.isna().mean()
        ip = g["yearly_iptu"]
        rec["median_yearly_iptu"] = pd.to_numeric(ip, errors="coerce").median()
        rec["missing_rate_iptu"] = ip.isna().mean()
        rec["faixa_vivareal"] = faixa(n)
        out.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(out)


purch = seg_purchase(vr)
save(purch, "purchase_segments.csv")

# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("6. INTEGRA├ç├âO COM AIRBNB")
metrics = pd.read_csv(OUT / "listing_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
metrics["suburb_canonical"] = metrics["suburb"].apply(norm_bairro)
metrics["bedrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(metrics["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce")
metrics["listing_type"] = metrics["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

metric["has_30"] = metric.get("n_prices_observed_H_30", pd.Series(dtype=int)).fillna(0) > 0
metric["has_60"] = metric.get("n_prices_observed_H_60", pd.Series(dtype=int)).fillna(0) > 0

pick = pd.read_csv(OUT / "pickup_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
pick = pick.merge(metrics[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"]],
                  on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left")


def seg_airbnb(df):
    out = {}
    for (grb, b, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
        out[(grb, b, tp)] = {
            "N_airbnb_91": len(g),

            "unavailability_91_median": g["unavailability_rate_H_91"].median(),

            "static_rev_60_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_60"].median() if has60 else np.nan,
        }
    return out


# pickup agregado por segmento
def seg_pickup(df):
    out = {}

        out[(grp, b, tp)] = {
            "N_pickup": len(g),
            "net_pickup_value_median": g["net_pickup_value_proxy"].median(),

    return out


ab_map = seg_airbnb(metric)
pk_map = seg_pickup(pick)

def faixa(n):
    if n < 5:
        return "critico_<5"
    if n < 20:
        return "pequeno_5-19"
    if n < 50:
        return "medio_20-49"
    return "grande_50+"


def norm_bairro(s):
    """Mapping expl├¡cito (sem fuzzy matching). Retorna None se n├úo defens├ível."""
    if s is None or (isinstance(s, float) and (pd.isna(s) or s == "")):
        return None
    s = str(s).strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    k = s.lower()
    mp = {
        "centro": "Centro",
        "meia praia": "Meia Praia",
        "meia praia - frente mar": "Meia Praia",
        "meia praia - frente-mar": "Meia Praia",
        "morretes": "Morretes",
        "tabuleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "taboleiro": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "tabuleiro dos oliveiras": "Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras",
        "sertao do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
        "sertaozinho": "Sertaozinho",
        "sertao do trombudo": "Sertao do Trombudo",
        "altas sao bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
        "alto sao bento": "Alto Sao Bento",
        "casa branca": "Casa Branca",
        "canto da praia": "Canto da Praia",
        "ilhota": "Ilhota",
        "varzea": "Varzea",
        "jardim praia mar": "Jardim Praiamar",
        "andorinha": "Andorinha",
        "estreito": "Estreito",
        "ocean tower": "Ocean Tower",
    }
    return mp.get(k, s.title())


# ============================================================
# 1. LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA DO VivaReal
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("1. LIMPEZA E AUDITORIA VivaReal")
vr = pd.read_csv(DATA / "VivaReal_Itapema.csv", dtype={"listing_id": str})
print("  linhas:", len(vr), "| ids unicos:", vr["listing_id"].nunique(),
      "| ocorrencias repetidas:", int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()))

dup = vr[vr["listing_id"].duplicated(keep=False)]
groups = dup.groupby("listing_id")
all_cols = vr.columns.tolist()
fields = ["sale_price", "usable_area", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "parking_spaces",
          "suburb", "listing_type", "business_types", "monthly_condo_fee", "yearly_iptu"]
exact = amen_only = other = 0
for gid, g in groups:
    base = g.iloc[0].fillna("__NA__")
    difset = set()
    for _, row in g.iloc[1:].fillna("__NA__").iterrows():
        for c in all_cols:
            if row[c] != base[c]:
                difset.add(c)
    if not difset:
        exact += 1
    elif difset <= {"amenities"}:
        amen_only += 1
    else:
        other += 1
key_consistent = 0
for gid, g in groups:
    if g[fields].fillna("__NA__").nunique().eq(1).all():
        key_consistent += 1
print(f"  grupos dup: {groups.ngroups} | {exact} c├│pias exatas, "
      f"{amen_only} diferem s├│ em emitters, {other} outras diverg├¬ncias")
print(f"  grupos com campos-chave 100% consistentes: {key_consistent}/{groups.ngroups}")

dup_audit = pd.DataFrame([{

    "listing_id_unicos": vr["listing_id"].nunique(),
    "ocorrencias_repetidas": int(vr["listing_id"].duplicated().sum()),
    "grupos": groups.ngroups,
    "copias_exatas": exact,
    "diferenc_so_amenities": amen_only,
    "diferenc_outras_colunas": other,
    "campos_chave_consistentes": key_consistent,
}])
save(dup_audit, "vivareal_duplicates_audit.csv")

vr = vr.drop_duplicates("listing_id", keep="first").copy()
print("  apos dedup linhas:", len(vr))

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)

print("  listing_type:", vr["listing_type"].value_counts().to_dict())
vr["is_residential_comparable"] = vr["listing_type"].isin(["apartamento", "casa"])
print("  residencial (apartamen+casa):", int(vr["is_residential_comparable"].sum()))

ambos = vr[vr["business_types"] == "Ambos"]

# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)

vr["suburb_original"] = vr["suburb"]

submap = (vr[["suburb_original", "suburb_canonical"]].value_counts()

save(submap, "vivareal_suburb_mapping.csv")
print("  mapeados:", int(vr["suburb_mapping_applied"].sum()),
      "| NA (sem direto):", int((vr["suburb_canonical"].isna()).sum()))
print(submap.to_string(index=False))

# ============================================================
# 4. OUTLIERS ÔÇö n├úo remover silenciosamente
# ============================================================
print("=" * 78)
print("4. OUTLIERS")
vr["sale_price_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["sale_price"], errors="coerce")
vr["usable_area_num"] = pd.to_numeric(vr["usable_area"], errors="coerce")
vr["price_per_m2"] = np.where(vr["usable_area_num"] > 0,
                              vr["sale_price_num"] / vr["usable_area_num"], np.nan)
print("  sale_price missing:", int(vr["sale_price_num"].isna().sum()),
      "| usable_area missing:", int(vr["usable_area_num"].isna().sum()),
      "| area<=0 (sem pre├ºo/m2):", int((vr["usable_area_num"] <= 0).sum()))
q = vr["sale_price_num"].describe()
print("  sale_price describe:\n", q.round(0))
iqr = q["75%"] - q["25%"]
vr["flag_outlier_price"] = (vr["sale_price_num"] > q["75%"] + 3 * iqr).astype(int)
pm2 = vr["price_per_m2"].quantile(0.99)
vr["flag_outlier_m2"] = (vr["price_per_m2"] > pm2).astype(int)
print("  flag_price_outlier:", int(vr["flag_outlier_price"].sum()),
      "| flag_m2_outlier:", int(vr["flag_outlier_m2"].sum()))

def seg_purchase(df):
    out = []
    for (subb, b, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
        n = len(g)
        sp = g["sale_price_num"].dropna()
        rec = {"suburb_canonical": subb, "bedrooms": b, "listing_type": tp, "N_sale": n}
        rec["median_sale_price"] = sp.median() if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["mean_sale_price"] = sp.mean() if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["p25_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.25) if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["p75_sale_price"] = sp.quantile(0.75) if len(sp) else np.nan
        rec["median_usable_area"] = g["usable_area_num"].median()
        rec["median_price_per_m2"] = g["price_per_m2"].median()
        cf = pd.to_numeric(g["monthly_condo_fee"], errors="coerce")
        rec["median_monthly_condo_fee"] = cf.median()
        rec["missing_rate_condo"] = cf.isna().mean()
        ip = pd.to_numeric(g["yearly_iptu"], errors="coerce")
        rec["median_yearly_iptu"] = ip.median()
        rec["missing_rate_iptu"] = ip.isna().mean()
        rec["faixa_vivareal"] = faixa(n)
        out.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(out)


purch = seg_purchase(vr)

metrics = pd.read_csv(OUT / "listing_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})

def airbnb_stats(df):
    out = {}
    for (subb, b, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
        g = g[g["n_prices_observed_H_91"].fillna(0) > 0]

        out[(subb, b, tp)] = {
            "N_airbnb_91": n,
            "ADR_91_median": g["median_available_price_H_91"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "unavailability_91_median": g["unavailability_rate_H_91"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "static_rev_91_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "static_rev_91_p25": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].quantile(0.25) if n else np.nan,
            "static_rev_91_p75": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_91"].quantile(0.75) if n else np.nan,
            "static_rev_30_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_30"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "static_rev_60_median": g["static_revenue_proxy_H_60"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "ADR_30_median": g["median_available_price_H_30"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "ADR_60_median": g["median_available_price_H_60"].median() if n else np.nan,
        }
    return out


def pickup_stats(df):
    out = {}
    for (subb, b, tp), g in df.groupby(["suburb_canonical", "bedrooms", "listing_type"], dropna=False):
        n = len(g)
        out[(subb, b, tp)] = {
            "N_pickup": n,
            "net_pickup_value_median": g["net_pickup_value_proxy"].median() if n else np.nan,
            "net_transition_rate_median": g["net_transition_rate"].median() if n else np.nan,
        }
    return out

Tudo reproduzido e reconciliado com a auditoria. Segue o relat├│rio. Todos os artefatos foram gerados em `outputs/tables/`.

## A. Auditoria e limpeza do VivaReal
- 8.329 linhas, **8.293** `listing_id` ├║nicos, **36** ocorr├¬ncias repetidas ÔåÆ **36 grupos**. Reproduzido.
- Dos 36 grupos: **35 c├│pias exatas**, **1 difere apenas em `amenities`**, 0 diverg├¬ncia em outras colunas ÔÇö exatamente como a auditoria.
- Verifica├º├úo de consist├¬ncia nos campos-chave (`sale_price, usable_area, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking_spaces, suburb, listing_type, business_types, monthly_condo_fee, yearly_iptu`): **36/36 grupos consistentes** ÔåÆ dedup por `listing_id` mantendo a primeira linha (8.293 ap├│s dedup). Salvo em `vivareal_duplicates_audit.csv`.

## B. Mapeamento aplicado
`suburb_original` preservada; `suburb_canonical` via mapping expl├¡cito (n├úo fuzzy). Exemplos: `meia praia`/`MEIA PRAIA`/`Meia Praia - Frente Mar` ÔåÆ `Meia Praia` (95+... consolidados); `Tabuleiro`/`Taboleiro` ÔåÆ `Tabuleiro dos Oliveiras`; `Sert├úo do Trombudo` ÔåÆ can├┤nico. `Itapema`, `Ocean Tower` e faltantes **n├úo** foram for├ºados a um bairro defens├ível (98 NA). Frente-mar mantida em `flag_frente_mar`. ÔåÆ `vivareal_suburb_mapping.csv`. **Nota:** "Meia Praia - Frente Mar" agrupou s├│ 1 item ÔÇö a flag existe mas o volume ├® residual.

## C. Principais pre├ºos de aquisi├º├úo (apartamento, mediana)
| Seg | N | mediana |
|---|---|---|
| Centro 1Q | 22 | R$ 890k |
| Centro 2Q | 89 | R$ 1,15M |
| Meia Praia 1Q | 58 | R$ 877,5k |
| Meia Praia 2Q | 243 | R$ 1,08M |
| Morretes 1Q | 50 | R$ 624,5k |
| Morretes 2Q | 1.037 | R$ 790k |
| Tabuleiro 2Q | 110 | R$ 780k |

## D. Ranking capital efficiency proxy (shortlist)
| Seg | cap_eff_91 | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Morretes 2Q | **0.0160** | moderada |
| Meia Praia 2Q | 0.0147 | forte |
| Centro 2Q | 0.0130 | forte |
| Centro 1Q | 0.0117 | moderada |
| Centro 3Q | 0.0116 | moderada |
| Meia Praia 3Q | 0.0106 | forte |
| Meia Praia 4Q | 0.0089 | moderada |

**N├úo declaro o 1┬║ como melhor investimento** (├® s├│ ordena├º├úo); v├írios trade-offs permanecem.

## E. Cen├írios conservative/base/optimistic (91d)
Ex. Morretes 2Q: **cons 0.0091 / base 0.0160 / opt 0.0270**. S├úo **cen├írios**, n├úo IC (combina P25/P75 das duas fontes de modo adverso/favor├ível).

## F. Static proxy ├ù pickup
- **Static (H91) roi** favre Meia Praia/Morretes 2Q.
- **Pickup mediana por listing**: Centro 2Q (R$3.983) e 1Q (R$3.470) > Meia Praia 2Q (R$1.542) > Morretes 2Q (R$0). ÔåÆ **o Centro tem intensidade de pickup superior**, contradizendo parcialmente o ranking por efici├¬ncia onde Morretes/Meia Praia est├úo ├á frente. Contradi├º├úo ├║til, n├úo escondida.

## G. Shortlist (N_airbnbÔëÑ20 & N_saleÔëÑ20)
7 segmentos (ver D). Exclu├¡ram os 1Q Morretes (N_airbnb=3), 1Q Meia Praia (16), 2Q Tabuleiro (12) por amostra min├║scula do lado Airbnb.

## H. Posi├º├úo preliminar sobre tese 1Q Centro
- **amostra suficiente**: N_airbnb=75, N_sale=22, evid├¬ncia **moderada**.
- `static_rev_91=10.416`, `mediana sale=890k`, `cap_eff=1.17%` ÔÇö **abaixo** de Morretes 2Q (1.60%), Meia Praia 2Q (1.47%) e Centro 2Q (1.30%). A tese **n├úo** ├® sustentada pela efici├¬ncia de capital na janela.
- **Por├®m** o pickup de Centro 1Q (R$3.470 mediana) ├® segundo maior ÔÇö a din├ómica de demanda ├® favor├ível ao compacto-Central, o que impede descartar a tese de imediato.

## I. Contradi├º├Áes que impedem conclus├úo autom├ítica
1. **Est├ítico vs pickup**: Meia Praia/Morretes 2Q lideram em efici├¬ncia; Centro lidera em pickup por listing. Dois rankings conflitantes.
2. Segmentos 1Q (Morretes, Meia Praia) e Tabuleiro t├¬m Airbnb **N<20** ÔåÆ curta evid├¬ncia, apesar de compram bem.
3. Horitzones (30/60) n├úo equaliz├íveis a anual; A proxy s├│ cobre janela observada (ver├úo, ~novoÔÇôabr).
4. Sem custos de opera├º├úo/gest├úo/IPTU/condom├¡nio incorporados ao cap_eff (proxy bruta).
5. VivaReal ├® oferta (pre├ºo anunciado), n├úo transa├º├úo realizada.

## J. Permite escolher 2-4 candidatos?
**Sim, preliminarmente, com resalva**: o ranking aponta candidatos **Morretes 2Q, Meia Praia 2Q, Centro 2Q** (efici├¬ncia) e **Centro 1Q** (din├ómica/pickup, a tese). A shortlist de 7 j├í cont├®m esses. A escolha final ainda exige decidir o peso entre efici├¬ncia est├ítica vs. pickup vs. N ÔÇö trade-off de Pareto que **n├úo** resolvo agora (sem score). Posso apresentar a **fronteira de Pareto** (cap_equil├¡brio ├ù pickup ├ù evid├¬ncia) na pr├│xima etapa quando voc├¬ definir prefer├¬ncia de risco/objetivo ÔÇö o objetivo 12 prev├¬ isso.

N├úo criei score arbitrado; n├úo escolhi vencedor; n├úo anualizai; n├úo usei ML. Todos os artefatos sob `outputs/tables/` coexistem (auditoria 01 + m├®tricas 02 + investimento 03).

Quer que eu, antes de qualquer recomenda├º├úo final, gere a **fronteira de Pareto** cap_efici├¬ncia ├ù pickup ├ù evid├¬ncia (item 12) para apo apoio ├á decis├úo 2-4 candidatos, ou prefere definir primeiro a pol├¡tica/objetivo?

+print("  hosts_latest:", len(hosts_latest), "| owner_id ├â┬║nicos:", hosts_latest["owner_id"].nunique())
+
+base = details.merge(mesh[["airbnb_listing_id", "suburb"]], on="airbnb_listing_id", how="inner")
+assert base["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "Details+Mesh n├â┬úo 1:1"
+base = base.merge(hosts_latest, on="owner_id", how="left")
+base = base.merge(metrics, on="airbnb_listing_id", how="left", suffixes=("", "_m"))
+assert base["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "base n├â┬úo 1:1"
+print("  base linhas:", len(base))
+
+# ---------- targets ----------
+tag_cols = [("A_static_rev", "static_revenue_proxy_H_91"),
+            ("B_adr", "median_available_price_H_91"),
+            ("C_unavail", "unavailability_rate_H_91")]
+for tag, col in tag_cols:
+    base[tag] = pd.to_numeric(base[col], errors="coerce")
+
+print("=" * 78)
+print("2/3. LEAKAGE ├óÔé¼ÔÇØ exclu├â┬¡dos (derivados de Price_AV)")
+PRICE_PREFIX = ["available_nights_H_", "unavailable_nights_H_", "unavailability_rate_H_",
+                "median_available_price_H_", "mean_available_price_H_", "p25_price_H_",
+                "p75_price_H_", "static_revenue_proxy_H_", "n_prices_observed_H_", "has_price_H_",
+                "is_in_price_av_20jan", "is_balanced_panel"]
+LEAK_SUBSTR = PRICE_PREFIX + ["available_to_unavailable", "unavailable_to_available",
+                              "net_unavailability", "net_transition_rate", "net_pickup_value",
+                              "pickup_value_proxy", "release_value_proxy"]
+EXCLUDED_FOR_LEAKAGE = [c for c in base.columns if any(p in c for p in LEAK_SUBSTR)]
+for c in EXCLUDED_FOR_LEAKAGE:
+    print("   exclu├â┬¡do:", c)
+
+print("=" * 78)
+print("3. FEATURES CANDIDATAS")
+base["n_beds"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_beds"], errors="coerce")
+base["n_guests"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_guests"], errors="coerce")
+base["n_bathrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_bathrooms"], errors="coerce")
+base["n_bedrooms"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce")
+base["listing_type_low"] = base["listing_type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
+base["cleaning_fee"] = pd.to_numeric(base["cleaning_fee"], errors="coerce")
+
+
+def to_bool(s):
+    s = str(s).strip().lower()
+    return 1 if s == "true" else (0 if s == "false" else np.nan)
+
+
+for c in ["can_instant_book", "is_professional", "is_new_listing", "is_guest_favorite"]:
+    base[c + "_b"] = base[c].apply(to_bool)
+base["picture_count"] = pd.to_numeric(base["picture_count"], errors="coerce")
+base["n_reviews"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_reviews"], errors="coerce")
+base["star_clean"] = pd.to_numeric(base["star_rating_clean"], errors="coerce")
+base["guest_sat"] = pd.to_numeric(base["guest_satisfaction_overall"], errors="coerce")
+base["is_superhost_b"] = base["is_superhost"].apply(to_bool)
+base["is_verified_b"] = base["is_verified"].apply(to_bool)
+base["n_reviews_host"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_reviews_host"], errors="coerce")
+base["star_host"] = pd.to_numeric(base["star_rating_host"], errors="coerce")
+base["years_host"] = pd.to_numeric(base["years_host"], errors="coerce")
+base["months_host"] = pd.to_numeric(base["months_host"], errors="coerce")
+base["suburb_clean"] = base["suburb"]
+base["amenities_count"] = base["amenities"].apply(count_amen)
+base["description_length"] = base["ad_description"].fillna("").astype(str).str.len()
+
+NUMERIC_FEATS = ["n_beds", "n_guests", "n_bathrooms", "n_bedrooms", "cleaning_fee",
+                 "picture_count", "n_reviews", "star_clean", "guest_sat",
+                 "n_reviews_host", "star_host", "years_host", "months_host",
+                 "amenities_count", "description_length"]
+BOOL_FEATS = ["can_instant_book_b", "is_professional_b", "is_new_listing_b",
+              "is_guest_favorite_b", "is_superhost_b", "is_verified_b"]
+CAT_FEATS = ["suburb_clean", "listing_type_low"]
+ALL_FEATS = NUMERIC_FEATS + BOOL_FEATS + CAT_FEATS
+
+# ============================================================
+# 5. QUALIDADE DAS FEATURES
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("5. QUALIDADE DAS FEATURES")
+qa_rows = []
+for f in ALL_FEATS:
+    s = base[f]
+    var = s.var() if s.dtype.kind in "fi" else np.nan
+    qa_rows.append({"feature": f, "missing_rate": round(s.isna().mean(), 4),
+                    "cardinalidade": int(s.nunique(dropna=False)),
+                    "dtype": str(s.dtype),
+                    "variancia": None if pd.isna(var) else round(float(var), 4)})
+feature_qa = pd.DataFrame(qa_rows)
+save(feature_qa, "driver_feature_audit.csv")
+drop_for_model = [f for f in ALL_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) <= 1]
+if drop_for_model:
+    print("  constantes (dropadas de modelagem, N├âãÆO removidas da base):", drop_for_model)
+
+# ============================================================
+# 6. AN├â┬üLISE UNIVARIADA
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("6. AN├â┬üLISE UNIVARIADA")
+TARGETS = [("A_static_rev", "static revenue"), ("B_adr", "ADR"), ("C_unavail", "unavailability")]
+
+num_rows = []
+for f in NUMERIC_FEATS:
+    for tgt, _ in TARGETS:
+        d = base[[f, tgt]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
+        rho = spearmanr(d[f], d[tgt]).correlation if len(d) >= 10 else np.nan
+        num_rows.append({"feature": f, "target": tgt, "n_valid": len(d), "spearman": rho})
+save(pd.DataFrame(num_rows), "driver_numeric_associations.csv")
+
+bin_rows = []
+for f in BOOL_FEATS:
+    for tgt, _ in TARGETS:
+        d = base[[f, tgt]].dropna(subset=[tgt, f])
+        tru = d[d[f] == 1][tgt]; fls = d[d[f] == 0][tgt]
+        if len(tru) < 1 or len(fls) < 1:
+            continue
+        bin_rows.append({"feature": f, "target": tgt,
+                         "N_true": int(len(tru)), "N_false": int(len(fls)),
+                         "med_true": tru.median(), "med_false": fls.median(),
+                         "diff_abs": tru.median() - fls.median(),
+                         "diff_pct": ((tru.median() - fls.median()) / fls.median())
+                         if fls.median() else np.nan})
+save(pd.DataFrame(bin_rows), "driver_binary_associations.csv")
+
+cat_rows = []
+for f in CAT_FEATS:
+    for tgt, _ in TARGETS:
+        d = base[[f, tgt]].dropna(subset=[tgt])
+        g = d.groupby(f, dropna=False)[tgt].agg(["median", "count",
+                                                 lambda s: s.quantile(0.25),
+                                                 lambda s: s.quantile(0.75)])
+        g.columns = ["mediana", "N", "p25", "p75"]
+        g = g.reset_index().rename(columns={f: "categoria"})
+        g["target"] = tgt
+        g["faixa_amostral"] = g["N"].apply(faixa)
+        cat_rows.append(g)
+save(pd.concat(cat_rows), "driver_categorical_associations.csv")
+print("  associa├â┬º├â┬Áes univariadas salvas.")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 9. MODELO RF + CV (com/sem bairro) ; 8. leitura localiza├â┬º├â┬úo
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("9. MODELO RF + CV (com/sem bairro)")
+
+
+def run_model(target_col, add_suburb):
+    num = [f for f in NUMERIC_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
+    binf = [f for f in BOOL_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
+    cat = (["suburb_clean"] if add_suburb else []) + ["listing_type_low"]
+    feats = num + binf + cat
+    d = base[feats + [target_col]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=[target_col]).copy()
+    if len(d) < 30:
+        return None
+    X = d[feats]; y = d[target_col]
+    ymed = y.median()
+    baseline_mae = (y - ymed).abs().mean()
+    pre = ColumnTransformer([
+        ("num", Pipeline([("imp", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
+                          ("sc", StandardScaler())]), num + binf),
+        ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat)])
+    pipe = Pipeline([("pre", pre),
+                     ("rf", RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=RS, n_jobs=-1))])
+    cv = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RS)
+    mae = -cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error")
+    r2 = cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="r2")
+    return {"target": target_col, "with_suburb": add_suburb, "n": len(d),
+            "baseline_mae": round(baseline_mae, 1),
+            "cv_mae": round(mae.mean(), 1), "cv_r2": round(r2.mean(), 4),
+            "mae_gain_vs_baseline": round(1 - mae.mean() / baseline_mae, 4)
+            if baseline_mae else np.nan}
+
+
+model_results = [r for r in (run_model(t, sub)
+                             for t, _ in TARGETS for sub in [True, False]) if r]
+save(pd.DataFrame(model_results), "driver_model_cv.csv")
+for r in model_results:
+    print(f"  {r['target']} sub={'Y' if r['with_suburb'] else 'N'}: n={r['n']} "
+          f"baseline_MAE={r['baseline_mae']} CV_MAE={r['cv_mae']} R2={r['cv_r2']} "
+          f"ganho_vs_baseline={r['mae_gain_vs_baseline']:.1%}")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 10. PERMUTATION IMPORTANCE
+# ============================================================
+print("=" * 78)
+print("10. PERMUTATION IMPORTANCE")
+
+
+def feats_for(add_suburb):
+    num = [f for f in NUMERIC_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
+    binf = [f for f in BOOL_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
+    cat = (["suburb_clean"] if add_suburb else []) + ["listing_type_low"]
+    return num + binf, cat
+
+
+perm_rows = []
+for tgt, _ in TARGETS:
+    for sub in [True, False]:
+        num, cat = feats_for(sub)
+        feats = num + cat
+        d = base[feats + [tgt]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=[tgt]).copy()
+        if len(d) < 50:
+            continue
+        X = d[feats]; y = d[tgt]
+        Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=RS)
+        pre = ColumnTransformer([
+            ("num", SimpleImputer(strategy="median"), num),
+            ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat)])
+        Xtrp = pre.fit_transform(Xtr); Xtep = pre.transform(Xte)
+        m = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=RS, n_jobs=-1)
+        m.fit(Xtrp, ytr)
+        perm = permutation_importance(m, Xtep, yte, n_repeats=10, random_state=RS,
+                                      scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error")
+# importance m├®dia por feature-base (agrupando colunas do transformer)
+        imp = perm.importances_mean
+        try:
+            names = list(pre.get_feature_names_out())
+        except Exception:
+            names = list(feats)
+        col_feat = {}
+        for nm in names:
+            toks = nm.split("__")
+            col_feat[nm] = toks[2] if len(toks) >= 3 else nm
+        for i, nm in enumerate(names):
+            if nm.startswith("num__"):
+                fb = nm.split("__")[-1]
+            else:
+                fb = col_feat.get(nm, nm)
+            if nm.startswith("cat__"):
+                for c in cat:
+                    if nm.startswith(f"cat__{c}"):
+                        fb = c
+                        break
+            perm_rows.append({"target": tgt, "with_suburb": sub, "feature": fb,
+                              "perm_imp": imp[i], "n": len(yte)})
+perm_grp = (pd.DataFrame(perm_rows).groupby(["target", "with_suburb", "feature"])
+            ["perm_imp"].mean().reset_index())
+save(perm_grp, "driver_permutation_importance.csv")
+print("  permutation importance salva (associa├º├úo, N├âO causalidade).")
+# ============================================================
+# 12. CANDIDATOS DA SHORTLIST ├óÔé¼ÔÇØ compara├â┬º├â┬úo expl├â┬¡cita
+# ============================================================
+print("="*78)
+print("12. CANDIDATOS DA SHORTLIST")
+cands = [("apartamento", 2, "Morretes"), ("apartamento", 2, "Meia Praia"),
+         ("apartamento", 2, "Centro"), ("apartamento", 1, "Centro")]
+base["bedr"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_bedrooms"], errors="coerce")
+base["typ_low"] = base["listing_type_low"]
+cb = base[base["A_static_rev"].notna()].copy()
+cand_rows = []
+for (typ, bed, subb) in cands:
+    seg = cb[(cb["typ_low"] == typ) & (cb["bedr"] == bed) & (cb["suburb_clean"] == subb)]
+    if seg.empty:
+        continue
+    feats = seg[NUMERIC_FEATS + BOOL_FEATS].dropna()
+    cand_rows.append({
+        "perfil": f"{typ} {bed}Q {subb}",
+        "N_airbnb": len(seg),
+        "ADR_med": seg["B_adr"].median(),
+        "unavail_med": seg["C_unavail"].median(),
+        "static_rev_91_med": seg["A_static_rev"].median(),
+        "n_bedrooms": seg["n_bedrooms"].median(),
+        "n_beds_med": seg["n_beds"].median(),
+        "n_guests_med": seg["n_guests"].median(),
+        "cleaning_fee_med": seg["cleaning_fee"].median(),
+        "n_reviews_med": seg["n_reviews"].median(),
+        "star_med": seg["star_clean"].median(),
+        "guest_fav_rate": seg["is_guest_favorite_b"].mean(),
+        "prof_rate": seg["is_professional_b"].mean(),
+        "superhost_rate": seg["is_superhost_b"].mean(),
+        "is_new_rate": seg["is_new_listing_b"].mean(),
+        "amenities_med": seg["amenities_count"].median(),
+    })
+cand_df = pd.DataFrame(cand_rows)
+save(cand_df, "candidate_driver_comparison.csv")
+print("  candidatos salvos.")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 13. SANITY CHECK CENTRO 1Q vs 2Q
+# ============================================================
+print("="*78)
+print("13. CENTRO 1Q vs 2Q")
+c1 = base[(base["typ_low"] == "apartamento") & (base["bedr"] == 1) & (base["suburb_clean"] == "Centro")]
+c2 = base[(base["typ_low"] == "apartamento") & (base["bedr"] == 2) & (base["suburb_clean"] == "Centro")]
+for nm, gg in [("1Q", c1), ("2Q", c2)]:
+    gg = gg[gg["A_static_rev"].notna()]
+    print(f"  {nm}: N={len(gg)} static={gg['A_static_rev'].median():.0f} "
+          f"ADR={gg['B_adr'].median():.0f} unav={gg['C_unavail'].median():.3f}")
+
+# ============================================================
+# 14. PARETO ├óÔé¼ÔÇØ confirmar/refutar
+# ============================================================
+print("="*78)
+print("14. FRONTEIRA DE PARETO (capital efficiency x net pickup value)")
+# leitura investment_segments
+try:
+    inv = pd.read_csv(OUT / "investment_segments.csv")
+    inv["suburb_low"] = inv["suburb"].astype(str).str.lower()
+    inv["typ_low"] = inv["listing_type"].astype(str).str.lower()
+    # confrontar a SHORTLIST: apenas apartamentos com N_airbnb>=20 e N_sale>=20
+    cand4 = [("Morretes", 2, "apartamento"), ("Meia Praia", 2, "apartamento"),
+             ("Centro", 2, "apartamento"), ("Centro", 1, "apartamento")]
+    rows = []
+    for (subb, bed, tp) in cand4:
+        m = inv[(inv["suburb"] == subb) & (inv["bedrooms"] == bed) & (inv["listing_type"] == tp)]
+        if m.empty:
+            continue
+        r = m.iloc[0]
+        rows.append({"suburb": subb, "bedrooms": bed, "listing_type": tp,
+                     "capital_efficiency_proxy_91": r["capital_efficiency_proxy_91"],
+                     "net_pickup_value_median": r["net_pickup_value_median"],
+                     "evidence_tier": r["evidence_tier"]})
+    pontos = pd.DataFrame(rows)
+    # n├úo-dominado: maximiza cap_eff e pickup
+    pts = pontos.to_dict("records")
+    nd = []
+    for i, a in enumerate(pts):
+        dominated = False
+        for j, b in enumerate(pts):
+            if i == j:
+                continue
+            if (b["capital_efficiency_proxy_91"] >= a["capital_efficiency_proxy_91"] and
+                b["net_pickup_value_median"] >= a["net_pickup_value_median"] and
+                (b["capital_efficiency_proxy_91"] > a["capital_efficiency_proxy_91"] or
+                 b["net_pickup_value_median"] > a["net_pickup_value_median"])):
+                dominated = True
+                break
+        nd.append(0 if dominated else 1)
+    pontos["nao_dominado"] = nd
+    save(pontos, "investment_pareto_front.csv")
+    print("  fronteira de Pareto (shortlist de 4 candidatos, max cap_eff + max pickup):")
+    for _, r in pontos.iterrows():
+        tag = "ND" if r["nao_dominado"] else "DOM"
+        print(f"   [{tag}] {r['suburb']} {int(r['bedrooms'])}Q: "
+              f"cap_eff={r['capital_efficiency_proxy_91']:.4f} pickup={r['net_pickup_value_median']:.0f}")
+except Exception as e:
+    print("  aviso pareto:", e)
+
+# ============================================================
+# 15. GR├â┬üFICOS
+# ============================================================
+print("="*78)
+print("15. GR├üFICOS")
+try:
+    pi = pd.read_csv(OUT / "driver_permutation_importance.csv")
+    for tgt, title in [("A_static_rev", "static revenue"),
+                       ("B_adr", "ADR"), ("C_unavail", "unavailability")]:
+        sub = pi[(pi["target"] == tgt) & (pi["with_suburb"] == True)].sort_values("perm_imp", ascending=True).tail(10)
+        if sub.empty:
+            continue
+        ax = sub.plot.barh(x="feature", y="perm_imp", figsize=(7, 5), legend=False, color="#888")
+        ax.set_title(f"Top drivers {title} (com bairro) ÔÇö perm. importance")
+        ax.set_xlabel("permutation importance (MAE)")
+        plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(FIG / f"driver_{tgt}.png", dpi=110); plt.close()
+        print("   fig:", f"driver_{tgt}.png")
+except Exception as e:
+    print("  aviso fig:", e)
+
+print("DONE")
+
+

A camada Airbnb e a an├ílise de investimento est├úo auditadas.

Agora precisamos responder de forma rigorosa ├á pergunta obrigat├│ria do desafio:

ÔÇ£Quais caracter├¡sticas explicam as melhores receitas?ÔÇØ

Crie:

src/04_revenue_drivers.py

N├âO altere data/.
N├âO mude os c├ílculos dos scripts 01/02/03.
N├âO fa├ºa recomenda├º├úo final ainda.
N├âO introduza fontes externas.
N├âO confunda associa├º├úo com causalidade.

O objetivo desta etapa ├® EXPLICABILIDADE, n├úo maximizar performance de um modelo.

==================================================

1. RECONSTRUIR BASE DE FEATURES SEM LEAKAGE
   ==================================================

Use:

Details_Itapema.csv
Hosts_ids_Itapema.csv
Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv
outputs/tables/listing_metrics.csv
outputs/tables/pickup_metrics.csv

Primeiro reconstrua hosts_latest:

* ordenar Hosts por host_snapshot_date;
* manter ├║ltimo snapshot por owner_id;
* garantir owner_id ├║nico;
* fazer assertion.

Fa├ºa join:

Details
1:1 Mesh
N:1 hosts_latest
1:1 listing_metrics

Depois do join, fa├ºa assertion de que continua existindo exatamente uma linha por airbnb_listing_id.

N├âO fa├ºa join direto com Hosts sem deduplica├º├úo.

==================================================
2. TARGETS
==========

Use tr├¬s targets separados:

TARGET A:
static_revenue_proxy_H_91

TARGET B:
median_available_price_H_91
(ADR anunciado)

TARGET C:
unavailability_rate_H_91

Opcionalmente, fa├ºa uma an├ílise secund├íria de:
net_transition_rate
e/ou
net_pickup_value_proxy

somente nos listings pertencentes ao painel pickup.

N├úo misture pickup com o target principal.

==================================================
3. PROIBI├ç├âO DE DATA LEAKAGE
============================

Para TARGET A, N├âO use como predictors:

median_available_price_H_91
mean_available_price
available_nights
unavailable_nights
unavailability_rate
static_revenue_proxy de outro H
pickup
qualquer vari├ível calculada diretamente do Price_AV

porque o target ├® constru├¡do a partir dessas vari├íveis.

Para TARGET B e C tamb├®m n├úo use qualquer vari├ível derivada do Price_AV como predictor.

Preditores devem representar caracter├¡sticas do im├│vel/an├║ncio/host/localiza├º├úo existentes independentemente do target.

Crie explicitamente uma lista:
EXCLUDED_FOR_LEAKAGE

e imprima-a no relat├│rio.

==================================================
4. FEATURES CANDIDATAS
======================

Utilize, quando existirem:

IM├ôVEL:

* number_of_bedrooms
* number_of_bathrooms
* number_of_beds
* number_of_guests
* listing_type

AN├ÜNCIO/OPERA├ç├âO:

* cleaning_fee
* can_instant_book
* is_professional
* is_new_listing
* is_guest_favorite
* picture_count
* number_of_reviews
* star_rating_clean
* guest_satisfaction_overall

HOST:

* is_superhost
* is_verified
* number_of_reviews_host
* star_rating_host
* years_host
* months_host

LOCALIZA├ç├âO:

* suburb

Se amenities estiver em formato lista/JSON-like:

* n├úo fa├ºa NLP complexo;
* extraia apenas uma contagem simples e reproduz├¡vel:
  amenities_count.

Pode fazer tamb├®m:

* description_length
* picture_count
  se os campos existirem.

N├úo use texto bruto em modelo.

==================================================
5. QUALIDADE DAS FEATURES
=========================

Para cada feature:

* missing rate;
* cardinalidade;
* distribui├º├úo;

# ============================================================
# 9. MODELO INTERPRET├üVEL (RF) + 8. controle de localiza├º├úo
# ============================================================
print("="*78)
print("7.-9. MODELO RF + CV (com e sem bairro)")

def build_pipe(include_suburb):
    num = [f for f in NUMERIC_FEATS if f in base.columns]
    binl = [f for f in BOOL_FEATS if f in base.columns]
    # drop constantes
    keep = [f for f in num+binl if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
    cat = [f for f in CAT_FEATS if f in base.columns] if include_suburb else [f for f in ["listing_type_low"] if f in base.columns]
    X = base[keep + cat].copy()
    y = None
    return keep, cat


def run_model(target_col, include_suburb):
    num = [f for f in NUMERIC_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
    binf = [f for f in BOOL_FEATS if base[f].nunique(dropna=False) > 1]
    cat = (["suburb_clean"] if include_suburb else []) + ["listing_type_low"]
    feats = num + binf + cat
    d = base[feats + [target_col]].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=[target_col]).copy()
    X = d[feats]
    y = d[target_col]
    if len(d) < 30:
        return None
    prepro = ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", Pipeline([("imp", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("sc", StandardScaler())]),
         num + binf),
        ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat),
    ])
    # baseline prev├¬ a mediana
    ymed = y.median()
    baseline_mae = (y - ymed).abs().mean()
    pipe = Pipeline([("pre", prepro), ("rf", RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=RS, n_jobs=-1))])
    cv = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RS)
    mae = -cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="neg_mean_absolute_error")
    r2 = cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="r2")
    return {"target": target_col, "with_suburb": include_suburb,
            "n": len(d), "baseline_mae": baseline_mae,
            "cv_mae": mae.mean(), "cv_r2": r2.mean(),
            "mae_gain_vs_baseline": 1 - mae.mean() / baseline_mae if baseline_mae else np.nan}

model_results = []
for tgt, _ in TARGETS:
    for sub in [True, False]:
        r = run_model(tgt, sub)

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, cross_val_score, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler

DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "tables"
FIG = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "outputs" / "figures"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FIG.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RS = 42


def save(df, name):
    df.to_csv(OUT / name, index=False)
    print("  saved ->", name, "(", len(df), "rows)")


def faixa(n):
    if n < 5:
        return "critico_<5"
    if n < 20:
        return "pequeno_5-19"
    if n < 50:
        return "medio_20-49"
    return "grande_50+"


def count_amen(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return 0

    except Exception:
        return 0


print("=" * 78)
print("1. BASE DE FEATURES")
details = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Details_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str, "owner_id": str}, low_memory=False)
hosts = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Hosts_ids_Itapema.csv", dtype={"owner_id": str})
mesh = pd.read_csv(DATA / "Mesh_Ids_Data_Itapema.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
metrics = pd.read_csv(OUT / "listing_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})
pickup = pd.read_csv(OUT / "pickup_metrics.csv", dtype={"airbnb_listing_id": str})

assert details["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "Details n├úo ├║nico"
assert mesh["airbnb_listing_id"].is_unique, "Mesh n├úo ├║nico"

hosts["host_snapshot_date"] = pd.to_datetime(hosts["host_snapshot_date"], errors="coerce")

print("  hosts_latest:", len(hosts_latest), "| owner_id ├║nicos:", hosts_latest["owner_id"].nunique())

base = base.merge(hosts_latest, on="owner_id", how="left")

for c in ["can_instant_book", "is_professional", "is_new_listing", "is_guest_favorite"]:

base["is_verified_b"] = base["is_verified"].apply(to_bool)
base["n_reviews_host"] = pd.to_numeric(base["number_of_reviews_host"], errors="coerce")
